settings.account.action.ends.description: A line of a moderators' action on the reader's account, in the lists of the settings page Account status and on the action's own page: when it ends or ended. state is until (in effect, with an end; date is the end), expired (it ended at date), lifted (a moderator lifted it at date), or anything else for an action in effect with no end. date is a date and a time as the reader's locale writes them. A line of a list: no full stop.

settings.account.action.appeal_state.defaultMessage: {state, select, open {你可以在 {date} 之前申诉} open_always {你可以申诉} passed {申诉期限已于 {date} 过去} pending {申诉审核中} upheld {申诉已审核：维持措施} overturned {申诉已审核：已解除措施} other {此措施已不能申诉}}
settings.account.action.appeal_state.description: A line of a moderators' action on the reader's account, in the lists of the settings page Account status: where its appeal stands. state is open (not appealed, can be until date), open_always (can be, no last day known), passed (not appealed, the last day was date), pending (appealed, waiting for the moderators), upheld (the moderators kept the action), overturned (they lifted it), or anything else for an action that was not appealed and cannot be. The words of pending, upheld and overturned are those of the page of an account kept out of the app (auth.status.appeal_state_label: Under review, Action kept, Action lifted). A line of a list: no full stop.

settings.account.action.section.what.description: A heading on the page of one moderators' action on the reader's account (settings.account.action.title), over what the action does to the account, in the server's words, and when it was taken and ends. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.action.section.reason.description: A heading on the page of one moderators' action on the reader's account, over the kind of reason (spam, a violation of the server's rules) and the moderators' explanation to the reader. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.action.section.posts.description: A heading on the page of one moderators' action on the reader's account, over the reader's posts the action acted on (marked as sensitive, or deleted). A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.action.issued.description: A line under what a moderators' action does, on the action's page in the settings: when the moderators took it. date is a date and a time as the reader's locale writes them. No full stop.

settings.account.action.reason.none.defaultMessage: 审核员没有为此措施给出说明。
settings.account.action.reason.none.description: Under the kind of reason of a moderators' action on the reader's account, on the action's page in the settings, when the moderators wrote no explanation to the reader.

settings.account.action.post.description: A row of the list Posts this action is about, on the page of a moderators' action in the settings: one of the reader's posts, named by when it was posted, which the row opens; the start of its text follows on the next line. date is a date and a time as the reader's locale writes them.

settings.account.action.posts.loading.description: In place of the list Posts this action is about, on the page of a moderators' action in the settings, while the posts are read from the server.

settings.account.action.posts.gone.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {# 条帖子已不在此服务器上，因此无法打开。}}
settings.account.action.posts.gone.description: Under the list Posts this action is about, on the page of a moderators' action in the settings: how many of the posts the action acted on were deleted (by the action or since) and so have no page to open. count is 1 or more.

settings.account.action.posts.failed.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {# 条帖子无法加载。请重新加载页面后再试。}}
settings.account.action.posts.failed.description: Under the list Posts this action is about, on the page of a moderators' action in the settings: how many of the posts the action acted on could not be read from the server now (it did not answer, or failed), which is not to say they are deleted (settings.account.action.posts.gone counts those). count is 1 or more.

settings.account.action.not_found.defaultMessage: 你的账号上没有此审核措施。请检查地址。
settings.account.action.not_found.description: In place of the page of a moderators' action at an address that names no action on the reader's account; the link to the page Account status follows it (settings.account.status).

settings.account.appeal.description: A heading on the page of one moderators' action on the reader's account, over the form in which the reader asks the moderators to reconsider the action, or over the appeal they sent and its result. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.appeal.about.defaultMessage: {deadline, select, yes {你可以对此措施申诉一次，截止到 {date}，发送后无法更改申诉。审核员会阅读并作出决定。} other {你可以对此措施申诉一次，发送后无法更改申诉。审核员会阅读并作出决定。}}
settings.account.appeal.about.description: Under the heading Appeal on the page of a moderators' action in the settings, over the appeal form: that an action is appealed once and the appeal cannot be changed, the last moment to appeal, and who decides. deadline is yes when the server says the last moment (date, a date and a time as the reader's locale writes them), no otherwise.

settings.account.appeal.label.description: The label of the field in which the reader writes their appeal of a moderators' action on their account (why the moderators should reconsider it), on the action's page in the settings; also the label over the appeal they sent, once it is sent.

settings.account.appeal.hint.defaultMessage: 说明审核员为什么应重新考虑此措施，最多 {max, number} 个字符。
settings.account.appeal.hint.description: The hint of the field settings.account.appeal.label. max is the longest appeal the server takes, in characters.

settings.account.appeal.missing.defaultMessage: 请先写下你的申诉再发送。
settings.account.appeal.missing.description: The error under the appeal field of a moderators' action, in the settings, when the reader sends it empty.

settings.account.appeal.over.defaultMessage: 你的申诉最多 {max, number} 个字符。
settings.account.appeal.over.description: The error under the appeal field of a moderators' action, in the settings, when what the reader wrote is longer than the server takes. max is the most characters.

settings.account.appeal.submit.description: The button at the bottom of the page of a moderators' action in the settings that sends the reader's appeal to the moderators. The page of an account kept out of the app says the same (auth.status.appeal_submit).

settings.account.appeal.not_sent.defaultMessage: {reason, select, field {申诉未发送。请检查上方标记的字段。} other {无法发送申诉。请检查网络连接后重试。}}
settings.account.appeal.not_sent.description: In the bar at the bottom of the page of a moderators' action in the settings, beside Send appeal, when the appeal was not sent. reason is field when what the reader wrote was refused (what is wrong stands under the field), other when the server could not be reached or answered with nothing the app knows.

settings.account.appeal.sent.description: Said under the heading Appeal on the page of a moderators' action in the settings, right after the reader sent their appeal; where the appeal stands follows it (settings.account.appeal.state).

settings.account.appeal.refused.defaultMessage: {reason, select, appealed {你已对此措施申诉过，每项措施只能申诉一次。你之前的申诉及其进展显示在此处。} closed {此措施的申诉期限已过，因此你的申诉未发送。如需联系审核员，请查看{about}上的联系方式。} not_appealable {此措施已不能申诉，因此你的申诉未发送。如需联系审核员，请查看{about}上的联系方式。} other {你的账号上已没有此措施，因此你的申诉未发送。请返回“账号状态”查看你账号上的措施。}}
settings.account.appeal.refused.description: Said under the heading Appeal on the page of a moderators' action in the settings when the server refused the appeal the reader sent; the form is then gone. reason is appealed (the action was appealed already, from another browser; that appeal then shows on the page), closed (the last moment to appeal has passed), not_appealable (the action cannot be appealed any more), or other (the action is not on the account any more). about is the link to the server's About page, whose words are settings.account.appeal.about_page; Account status is settings.account.status.

settings.account.appeal.about_page.description: The words of the link in settings.account.appeal.refused (its about) that leads to the server's About page (app.footer_about), where the server's contact is. It stands inside a sentence: no capital, no full stop.

settings.account.appeal.unsent.description: The label over the text of the appeal the reader wrote, on the page of a moderators' action in the settings, after the server refused the appeal because the action can no longer be appealed: the text stays to be read and copied.

settings.account.appeal.unsent.about.defaultMessage: 如果你想通过其他方式发给审核员，请复制它。离开此页面后不会保留。
settings.account.appeal.unsent.about.description: Under the text of the appeal that was not sent (settings.account.appeal.unsent): what the reader can do with it, and that it is gone once they leave the page.

settings.account.appeal.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, pending {你的申诉正在等待审核员审核。结果会通知你。} upheld {审核员已审核你的申诉，并维持该措施。} overturned {审核员已审核你的申诉，并解除该措施。} other {你已对此措施申诉。}}
settings.account.appeal.state.description: Under the heading Appeal on the page of a moderators' action in the settings, once the reader appealed it: where the appeal stands, read alone when the page is opened later. state is pending, upheld (the action stays), or overturned (the action is lifted). The first sentence of each is the page of an account kept out of the app's (server:auth.status.appeal_state).

settings.account.appeal.sent_on.description: A line under where the reader's appeal of a moderators' action stands, on the action's page in the settings: when they sent it. date is a date and a time as the reader's locale writes them. No full stop.

settings.account.appeal.decided_on.description: A line under settings.account.appeal.sent_on, once the moderators decided the reader's appeal: when they did. date is a date and a time as the reader's locale writes them. No full stop.

settings.account.appeal.answer.description: The label over the moderators' explanation of their decision on the reader's appeal, on the page of a moderators' action in the settings. The page of an account kept out of the app says the same (auth.status.appeal_answer).

settings.account.appeal.closed.defaultMessage: {deadline, select, yes {你没有对此措施申诉，申诉期限已于 {date} 过去。} other {此措施已不能申诉。}}
settings.account.appeal.closed.description: Under the heading Appeal on the page of a moderators' action in the settings, when the reader did not appeal the action and no longer can. deadline is yes when the last moment to appeal is known and has passed (date, a date and a time as the reader's locale writes them), no otherwise.

settings.account.appeal.leave.title.description: The question of the confirmation that opens when the reader leaves the page of a moderators' action with an appeal they wrote and did not send.

settings.account.appeal.leave.text.defaultMessage: 你写的内容将会丢失。此操作无法撤销。
settings.account.appeal.leave.text.description: The text of the confirmation that asks whether to leave the page of a moderators' action without sending the appeal written there.

settings.account.appeal.leave.confirm.description: The button of the confirmation that leaves the page of a moderators' action and drops the appeal the reader wrote and did not send.

settings.account.appeal.leave.cancel.description: The button of the confirmation that stays on the page of a moderators' action, with the appeal as the reader wrote it.

settings.account.data.description: A heading on the settings page Account and data, over the rows that lead to Export, Import and Delete old posts automatically. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.arrival.description: A heading on the settings page Account and data, over the row that leads to Aliases: what prepares a move from another account to this one. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.export.description: A row of the section Data and posts on the settings page Account and data, and the title of the page it opens, where the reader requests and downloads an archive of their account and downloads CSV files. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.export.row.about.defaultMessage: 账号归档，以及作为 CSV 文件的关注、屏蔽、静音和书签
settings.account.export.row.about.description: The line under the row Export on the settings page Account and data while no archive is being prepared or ready: what the page holds. A phrase without a full stop.

settings.account.export.row.standing.defaultMessage: {state, select, preparing {正在准备归档} ready_until {归档已就绪，可下载至 {date}} other {归档已就绪，可以下载}}
settings.account.export.row.standing.description: The line under the row Export on the settings page Account and data, in place of settings.account.export.row.about, while the reader's archive is being prepared (state preparing) or can be downloaded (ready_until with date, the day the server removes it, as the reader's locale writes a date; anything else when no day is known). Without a full stop.

settings.account.export.archive.description: A heading on the settings page Export, over the archive of the reader's account: the ZIP file the server prepares on request. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.export.archive.about.defaultMessage: 一个 ZIP 文件，包含你的个人资料、帖子、关键词筛选器、私人备注、你账号上的审核措施，以及你的关注、屏蔽、静音和书签。服务器会在后台准备，可能需要一些时间。
settings.account.export.archive.about.description: Under the heading Archive on the settings page Export: what the archive holds and that it is not ready at once.

settings.account.export.archive.loading.description: In the section Archive of the settings page Export while the reader's requests for an archive are read from the server.

settings.account.export.archive.failed_r.description: In the section Archive of the settings page Export when the reader's requests for an archive could not be read (the network, the server); Try again follows it (settings.retry).

settings.account.export.archive.none.description: In place of the list in the section Archive of the settings page Export while the reader has requested no archive lately; the button Request an archive follows it (settings.account.export.archive.request).

settings.account.export.archive.request.description: The button of the section Archive on the settings page Export that asks the server to prepare an archive of the reader's account.

settings.account.export.archive.requeste.description: The status of the section Archive on the settings page Export right after the reader pressed Request an archive and the server took the request; the list under it says where the archive stands.

settings.account.export.archive.building.defaultMessage: 已有归档正在准备。完成后你可以再请求一个。
settings.account.export.archive.building.description: The status of the section Archive on the settings page Export when the server refused a request because it is still preparing an earlier archive.

settings.account.export.archive.request_.description: The status of the section Archive on the settings page Export when the request for an archive got no answer from the server (the network).

settings.account.export.archive.download.description: In the row of an archive in the list Archive on the settings page Export, under where it stands, when the download of that archive failed.

settings.account.export.archive.row.description: The name of a row of the list Archive on the settings page Export: one archive, named by when the reader requested it. date is a date and a time as the reader's locale writes them. It does not say that it was requested: the status over the list says so right after a request (settings.account.export.archive.requested). No full stop.

settings.account.export.archive.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, preparing {此归档正在准备。你可以先离开此页面，就绪后再请求另一个。} ready {你可以在 {date} 之前下载此归档。} expired {此归档已于 {date} 过期。请重新请求。} other {无法准备此归档。请重新请求。}}
settings.account.export.archive.state.description: Under the name of an archive in the list Archive on the settings page Export: where it stands, the row's one line about it. state is preparing (the server is building it), ready (it can be downloaded until date, when the server removes it), expired (date has passed), or anything else when the server could not build it. date is a day as the reader's locale writes it.

settings.account.export.download.description: The button of a row on the settings page Export that saves that row's file to the reader's device: an archive that is ready, or one of the CSV files. The row names the file.

settings.account.export.saved.description: In a row of the settings page Export, under its name, once the reader pressed that row's Download and the browser was given the file. name is the file's name, such as following_accounts.csv.

settings.account.export.csv.description: A heading on the settings page Export, over the list of what the reader can download as a CSV file each. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.export.csv.about.defaultMessage: 你的关注、屏蔽、静音和书签，每种一个文件，采用 Mastodon 使用的格式，可导入到其他账号。Mastodon 没有已关注话题标签的文件：只有运行本软件的服务器才能导入该文件。
settings.account.export.csv.about.description: Under the heading CSV files on the settings page Export: what the files are and what they are for, and that the file of the row Followed hashtags (settings.account.csv.kind) is read only by this software.

settings.account.export.csv.failed.description: In a row of the list CSV files on the settings page Export, under its name, when the download of that row's file failed.

settings.account.csv.kind.defaultMessage: {kind, select, following {关注} followed_tags {已关注的话题标签} blocks {已屏蔽的账号} mutes {已静音的账号} domain_mutes {已静音的服务器} other {书签}}
settings.account.csv.kind.description: What a CSV file lists, in the settings: the name of a row of the list CSV files on the page Export, an option of What the file lists on the page Import, and the name of an import in the list Recent imports. kind is what the file lists: following, followed_tags, blocks, mutes, domain_mutes, or bookmarks. The same names as the lists of the settings page Relationships (settings.relationships.list). No full stop.

settings.account.import.description: A row of the section Data and posts on the settings page Account and data, and the title of the page it opens, where the reader imports a CSV file. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.import.row.about.defaultMessage: 从 CSV 文件导入关注、屏蔽、静音和书签
settings.account.import.row.about.description: The line under the row Import on the settings page Account and data while no import is in progress: what the page holds. A phrase without a full stop.

settings.account.import.row.standing.defaultMessage: 正在导入：已完成 {processed, number} / {total, number}
settings.account.import.row.standing.description: The line under the row Import on the settings page Account and data, in place of settings.account.import.row.about, while the server carries out an import of the reader: how many of its entries are done. Without a full stop.

settings.account.import.file.section.description: A heading on the settings page Import, over the form: what the file lists, the file, and how it is imported. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.import.about.defaultMessage: 请选择从此服务器或 Mastodon 导出的 CSV 文件。在你选择“导入”之前不会有任何更改。
settings.account.import.about.description: Under the heading File on the settings page Import: which files can be imported, and that choosing one does nothing yet. Import is the button settings.account.import.submit.

settings.account.import.kind.description: The label of the choice on the settings page Import of what the CSV file lists; its options are settings.account.csv.kind.

settings.account.import.file.description: The label of the field on the settings page Import that holds the file the reader chose from their device.

settings.account.import.file.choose.defaultMessage: {chosen, select, yes {选择其他文件} other {选择文件}}
settings.account.import.file.choose.description: The button of the field CSV file on the settings page Import that opens the device's file picker. chosen is yes once the field holds a file, whose name stands after the button.

settings.account.import.file.none.description: Beside the button Choose a file on the settings page Import while the field holds no file, where the file's name stands once one is chosen. No full stop.

settings.account.import.file.missing.defaultMessage: 请选择要导入的 CSV 文件。
settings.account.import.file.missing.description: Under the field CSV file on the settings page Import when the reader pressed Import without having chosen a file.

settings.account.import.file.unread.defaultMessage: 无法将此文件作为 CSV 文件读取。请选择另一个。
settings.account.import.file.unread.description: Under the field CSV file on the settings page Import when the browser could not read the file, or the server could not read it and gave no reason of its own.

settings.account.import.file.too_large.defaultMessage: “{name}”过大：文件最多 {max, number} 个字符。请选择更小的文件。
settings.account.import.file.too_large.description: Under the field CSV file on the settings page Import when the file the reader chose is longer than the server takes, the field then holding no file, or when the server refused the request as too large (413) as it previewed or started the import, the field then keeping the file. name is the file's name; max is 1000000.

settings.account.import.file.empty.defaultMessage: 此文件中没有与“文件所列内容”相符的内容。请检查该选项，或选择另一个文件。
settings.account.import.file.empty.description: Under the field CSV file on the settings page Import when the reader pressed Import and the server found no entry of the chosen kind in the file. What the file lists is the choice settings.account.import.kind.

settings.account.import.mode.description: The label of the choice on the settings page Import between merging the file into what the reader has and replacing it; its options are settings.account.import.mode.choice.

settings.account.import.mode.choice.description: An option of How to import on the settings page Import, and a fact of an import in the list Recent imports: mode is overwrite (what the reader has becomes exactly what the file lists) or merge (the file's entries are added). No full stop.

settings.account.import.mode.about.defaultMessage: {mode, select, overwrite {让列表与文件所列完全一致：你现有的、文件中没有的内容会被移除。} other {把文件所列内容添加到你现有的内容中，不移除任何内容。}}
settings.account.import.mode.about.description: The line under How to import on the settings page Import: what the chosen way does. mode is as in settings.account.import.mode.choice.

settings.account.import.preview.description: A heading on the settings page Import, over what importing the chosen file would do, before anything changes. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.import.preview.about.defaultMessage: 这是服务器在文件中读到的内容。导入时会查找其他服务器上的账号和帖子。
settings.account.import.preview.about.description: Under the heading Preview on the settings page Import: where the numbers come from, and that an account or a post on another server may still not be found later.

settings.account.import.preview.waiting.defaultMessage: {state, select, idle {选择文件以查看导入会做什么。} pending {正在读取文件…} other {无法读取文件，因此没有可预览的内容。}}
settings.account.import.preview.waiting.description: In the section Preview of the settings page Import while it has no preview to show: state is idle (no file chosen yet), pending (the server is reading the file), or anything else when the file was refused, which the field CSV file explains.

settings.account.import.preview.add.defaultMessage: {kind, select, following {{count, plural, =0 {没有要新关注的账号} other {# 个要新关注的账号}}} followed_tags {{count, plural, =0 {没有要新关注的话题标签} other {# 个要新关注的话题标签}}} blocks {{count, plural, =0 {没有要新屏蔽的账号} other {# 个要新屏蔽的账号}}} mutes {{count, plural, =0 {没有要新静音的账号} other {# 个要新静音的账号}}} domain_mutes {{count, plural, =0 {没有要新静音的服务器} other {# 个要新静音的服务器}}} other {{count, plural, =0 {没有要新加书签的帖子} other {# 条要新加书签的帖子}}}}
settings.account.import.preview.add.description: A fact of the Preview on the settings page Import: how many entries of the file the import would add to what the reader has. count is 0 or more. kind is what the file lists: following, followed_tags, blocks, mutes, domain_mutes, or bookmarks. No full stop.

settings.account.import.preview.present.defaultMessage: {kind, select, following {{count, plural, other {# 个你已关注的账号}}} followed_tags {{count, plural, other {# 个你已关注的话题标签}}} blocks {{count, plural, other {# 个你已屏蔽的账号}}} mutes {{count, plural, other {# 个你已静音的账号}}} domain_mutes {{count, plural, other {# 个你已静音的服务器}}} other {{count, plural, other {# 条你已加书签的帖子}}}}
settings.account.import.preview.present.description: A fact of the Preview on the settings page Import: how many entries of the file the reader has already, which the import leaves as they are. count is 1 or more. kind is what the file lists: following, followed_tags, blocks, mutes, domain_mutes, or bookmarks. No full stop.

settings.account.import.preview.remove.defaultMessage: {kind, select, following {{count, plural, =0 {没有要取消关注的账号} other {# 个要取消关注的账号，文件中没有}}} followed_tags {{count, plural, =0 {没有要取消关注的话题标签} other {# 个要取消关注的话题标签，文件中没有}}} blocks {{count, plural, =0 {没有要取消屏蔽的账号} other {# 个要取消屏蔽的账号，文件中没有}}} mutes {{count, plural, =0 {没有要取消静音的账号} other {# 个要取消静音的账号，文件中没有}}} domain_mutes {{count, plural, =0 {没有要取消静音的服务器} other {# 个要取消静音的服务器，文件中没有}}} other {{count, plural, =0 {没有要移除的书签} other {# 个要移除的书签，文件中没有}}}}
settings.account.import.preview.remove.description: The one fact under What “Replace” removes (settings.account.import.preview.removes) in the Preview on the settings page Import, when the reader chose Replace: how many things the reader has now that the file does not list, which the import would remove. count is 0 or more. kind is what the file lists: following, followed_tags, blocks, mutes, domain_mutes, or bookmarks. No full stop.

settings.account.import.preview.skipped.description: A fact of the Preview on the settings page Import: how many lines of the file are no entries and are left out, each with why under it (settings.account.import.preview.skipped.line). count is 1 or more. No full stop.

settings.account.import.preview.skipped..defaultMessage: {reason, select, duplicate {第 {line, number} 行与前面的行重复：“{value}”} other {第 {line, number} 行无法读取：“{value}”}}
settings.account.import.preview.skipped..description: A line under settings.account.import.preview.skipped on the settings page Import: one line of the file the import leaves out. line is its number in the file, value is the line as the file writes it, which stands in quotation marks so that it does not read as the app's own words, reason is duplicate (an earlier line names the same thing) or invalid (it names no account, hashtag, server or post). No full stop.
The last line under settings.account.import.preview.skipped on the settings page Import when the file has more lines that cannot be read than the page writes out: how many more. No full stop.

settings.account.import.preview.removes.description: In the section Preview of the settings page Import when the reader chose Replace: the name over what the import would remove (settings.account.import.preview.remove), which stands last and apart from what it adds and skips. Replace is the option settings.account.import.mode.choice. No full stop.

settings.account.import.submit.description: The button in the bar at the bottom of the settings page Import that sends the chosen file to the server to be imported.

settings.account.import.submit.removes.defaultMessage: {kind, select, following {{count, plural, other {导入会取消关注 # 个账号。}}} followed_tags {{count, plural, other {导入会取消关注 # 个话题标签。}}} blocks {{count, plural, other {导入会取消屏蔽 # 个账号。}}} mutes {{count, plural, other {导入会取消静音 # 个账号。}}} domain_mutes {{count, plural, other {导入会取消静音 # 个服务器。}}} other {{count, plural, other {导入会移除 # 个书签。}}}}
settings.account.import.submit.removes.description: In the bar at the bottom of the settings page Import, right before Import, while Replace is chosen and the import would remove something: how many things the reader has now that the file does not list, which the import removes and cannot put back. count is 1 or more. kind is what the file lists: following, followed_tags, blocks, mutes, domain_mutes, or bookmarks. One short sentence.

settings.account.import.refused.defaultMessage: 未导入任何内容。请修正标记的内容。
settings.account.import.refused.description: In the bar at the bottom of the settings page Import, beside Import, when something is wrong with the file, which the field CSV file says.

settings.account.import.failed.description: In the bar at the bottom of the settings page Import, beside Import, when the server did not take the import and gave no reason of its own (the network).

settings.account.import.running.defaultMessage: 另一个导入仍在进行。请在其完成后再开始此导入。
settings.account.import.running.description: In the bar at the bottom of the settings page Import, beside Import, when the server refused the import because it is still carrying out an earlier one of the reader.

settings.account.import.started.defaultMessage: 导入已开始。它会在后台继续进行，你可以离开此页面。
settings.account.import.started.description: The status of the section Recent imports on the settings page Import right after the server took the reader's import; the list under it says how far it is.

settings.account.import.replace.title.defaultMessage: {kind, select, following {替换你的关注？} followed_tags {替换你已关注的话题标签？} blocks {替换你已屏蔽的账号？} mutes {替换你已静音的账号？} domain_mutes {替换你已静音的服务器？} other {替换你的书签？}}
settings.account.import.replace.title.description: The question of the confirmation that opens when the reader presses Import on the settings page Import with Replace chosen and the import would remove something. kind is what the file lists: following, followed_tags, blocks, mutes, domain_mutes, or bookmarks.

settings.account.import.replace.text.defaultMessage: {kind, select, following {{count, plural, other {你将取消关注文件中没有的 # 个账号。}}此操作无法撤销。} followed_tags {{count, plural, other {你将取消关注文件中没有的 # 个话题标签。}}此操作无法撤销。} blocks {{count, plural, other {你将取消屏蔽文件中没有的 # 个账号。}}此操作无法撤销。} mutes {{count, plural, other {你将取消静音文件中没有的 # 个账号。}}此操作无法撤销。} domain_mutes {{count, plural, other {你将取消静音文件中没有的 # 个服务器。}}此操作无法撤销。} other {{count, plural, other {文件中没有的 # 个书签将被移除。}}此操作无法撤销。}}
settings.account.import.replace.text.description: The text of the confirmation that asks whether to replace what the reader has with what the file lists, on the settings page Import: what the import removes, and that it cannot be undone. count is 1 or more. kind is what the file lists: following, followed_tags, blocks, mutes, domain_mutes, or bookmarks.

settings.account.import.replace.confirm.description: The button of the confirmation on the settings page Import that starts the import that replaces what the reader has.

settings.account.import.replace.cancel.description: The button of the confirmation on the settings page Import that closes it without importing anything.

settings.account.import.recent.description: A heading on the settings page Import, over the list of the imports the reader started in the last 7 days. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.import.recent.about.defaultMessage: 服务器在后台执行导入。找不到或无法处理的账号或帖子会计为失败。导入会在列表中保留 7 天。
settings.account.import.recent.about.description: Under the heading Recent imports on the settings page Import: how an import runs, what failed means in a row's state (settings.account.import.row.state), and how long a row stays.

settings.account.import.recent.loading.description: In the section Recent imports of the settings page Import while the reader's imports are read from the server.

settings.account.import.recent.failed.description: In the section Recent imports of the settings page Import when the reader's imports could not be read (the network, the server); Try again follows it (settings.retry).

settings.account.import.recent.none.description: In place of the list Recent imports on the settings page Import while the server lists no import of the reader.

settings.account.import.row.started.description: A fact under the name of an import in the list Recent imports on the settings page Import, after Merge or Replace on the same line: when the reader started it. date is a date and a time as the reader's locale writes them. No full stop.

settings.account.import.row.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, running {进行中：已完成 {processed, number} / {total, number}} nothing {已结束：无需处理} done {已结束：全部 {total, number} 项已完成} partly {已结束：{total, number} 项中完成 {done, number} 项，失败 {failed, number} 项。请用“合并”再次导入该文件以重试其余部分。} other {已结束：全部 {total, number} 项失败。请用“合并”再次导入该文件以重试。}}
settings.account.import.row.state.description: Under the facts of an import in the list Recent imports on the settings page Import: where it stands. state is running (the server is carrying it out; processed of total are done), nothing (it finished with nothing to add or remove), done (all of total were carried out), partly (done were carried out and failed could not be), or anything else when none of total could be. After a failure it says what to do next: the server carries out every entry of a file again when it is imported again, finds the ones it has already done, and tries the others; Merge is the option settings.account.import.mode.choice. No full stop while nothing failed.

settings.account.auto_delete.description: A row of the section Data and posts on the settings page Account and data, and the title of the page it opens, where the reader chooses whether their posts are deleted once they pass an age, and which are kept. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.row.about.defaultMessage: 帖子超过你选择的时长后自动删除
settings.account.auto_delete.row.about.description: The line under the row Delete old posts automatically on the settings page Account and data until the reader's settings are read: what the page holds. A phrase without a full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.row.standin.defaultMessage: {enabled, select, on {已开启：超过 {days, plural, other {# 天}}的帖子会被删除} other {已关闭}}
settings.account.auto_delete.row.standin.description: The line under the row Delete old posts automatically on the settings page Account and data: whether the automatic deletion is on, and past which age it deletes. days is 1 or more. Without a full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.loading.defaultMessage: 正在加载你的旧帖子设置…
settings.account.auto_delete.loading.description: On the settings page Delete old posts automatically while the reader's settings are read from the server.

settings.account.auto_delete.failed.defaultMessage: 无法加载你的旧帖子设置。
settings.account.auto_delete.failed.description: On the settings page Delete old posts automatically when the reader's settings could not be read (the network, the server); Try again follows it (settings.retry).

settings.account.auto_delete.bound.defaultMessage: {state, select, from {自 {date} 起，此服务器的限制适用于你的帖子} now {此服务器的限制适用于你的帖子} other {此服务器的限制将适用于你的帖子}}
settings.account.auto_delete.bound.description: The heading of the summary at the top of the settings page Delete old posts automatically for a reader whose saved settings keep posts longer than the server's maximum allows; also the line under the row Delete old posts automatically on the settings page Account and data for that reader. state is from (the maximum starts to apply on date, a day as the reader's locale writes it), now (it applies already), or anything else while the server has not yet said from when. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.bound.about.defaultMessage: {state, select, now {你已不能再保留{items}{counted, select, yes {：你的 {count, number} 条帖子正在被删除} more {：你的超过 {count, number} 条帖子正在被删除} other {}}。保存此页面会让你的设置符合限制。} other {之后你将不能再保留{items}{counted, select, yes {：届时你的 {count, number} 条帖子将被删除} more {：届时你的超过 {count, number} 条帖子将被删除} none {：届时你的帖子都不会被删除} other {}}。保存此页面会立即应用该限制。}}
settings.account.auto_delete.bound.about.description: Under settings.account.auto_delete.bound, in two short sentences: what changes for this account when the server's maximum applies, how many posts are deleted then, and what saving does. state is as in settings.account.auto_delete.bound. items is what the reader's saved settings keep and the maximum does not, each as settings.account.auto_delete.keep.item, joined as the reader's language joins a list (two at most and “more below” when more differ). counted is yes when the server counted count posts (1 or more), more when it stopped counting at count (1000), none when it counted none, and anything else while the count is not known.

settings.account.auto_delete.section.whe.description: A heading on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, over whether the deletion is on and the age past which a post is deleted. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.when.about.defaultMessage: 超过下方时长的帖子会像你自己删除一样被删除：在此服务器和发送到的服务器上都会删除。此操作无法撤销。你对他人帖子的转发不会被删除。
settings.account.auto_delete.when.about.description: Under the heading When posts are deleted on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, on a server that sets no maximum for the reader: what a deletion is.

settings.account.auto_delete.when.about_.defaultMessage: 此服务器最多保留帖子 {days, plural, other {# 天}}。超过下方时长的帖子会在此服务器和发送到的服务器上被删除。此操作无法撤销。你对他人帖子的转发不会被删除。
settings.account.auto_delete.when.about_.description: Under the heading When posts are deleted on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, on a server whose maximum applies to the reader and that their saved settings are within: the maximum, and what a deletion is. days is the maximum. A reader the maximum binds reads it in the summary instead (settings.account.auto_delete.bound.about) and settings.account.auto_delete.when.about here.

settings.account.auto_delete.enabled.description: The label of the choice on the settings page Delete old posts automatically between deleting old posts and not; its options are settings.account.auto_delete.enabled.choice.

settings.account.auto_delete.enabled.cho.description: An option of Automatic deletion on the settings page Delete old posts automatically.

settings.account.auto_delete.enabled.fix.defaultMessage: 此服务器始终会删除旧帖子，因此无法关闭。
settings.account.auto_delete.enabled.fix.description: Under Automatic deletion on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, on a server whose maximum applies to the reader: why the choice shows On and cannot be changed; also said there when the server refused a save that turned it off.

settings.account.auto_delete.days.defaultMessage: 删除早于以下天数的帖子
settings.account.auto_delete.days.description: The label of the number field on the settings page Delete old posts automatically that holds the age, in days, past which a post is deleted; the unit days follows the field (settings.account.auto_delete.days.unit).

settings.account.auto_delete.days.unit.description: The unit after the number field Delete posts older than on the settings page Delete old posts automatically.

settings.account.auto_delete.days.about.description: The line under Delete posts older than on the settings page Delete old posts automatically: the ages the field takes. max is the most days: the server's maximum where it sets one for the reader, else 3650. No full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.days.rule.defaultMessage: 请输入 1 到 {max, number} 之间的整数天数。
settings.account.auto_delete.days.rule.description: Under the number field Delete posts older than on the settings page Delete old posts automatically when it is empty as the reader presses Save, or the server refused its value. max is the most days the field takes.

settings.account.auto_delete.section.kep.description: A heading on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, over the checkboxes of the kinds of posts that are never deleted. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.kept.about.defaultMessage: 符合其中任何一项的帖子，无论多旧都不会被删除。
settings.account.auto_delete.kept.about.description: Under the heading Posts that are kept on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, over its checkboxes.

settings.account.auto_delete.kept.fixed.defaultMessage: 此服务器不允许你按类型保留帖子。
settings.account.auto_delete.kept.fixed.description: In the section Posts that are kept of the settings page Delete old posts automatically, in place of its checkboxes, on a server whose maximum allows none of the kinds (pinned, bookmarked, favourited, with media, with a poll, articles).

settings.account.auto_delete.kept.rule.defaultMessage: 此服务器不允许你保留所勾选的某一类型。请重新加载页面，查看可勾选的类型。
settings.account.auto_delete.kept.rule.description: Under the checkboxes of Posts that are kept, or of Posts kept by audience, on the settings page Delete old posts automatically when the server refused a save because it no longer allows one of the checked kinds; in the bar at the bottom where the section shows no checkbox.

settings.account.auto_delete.keep.defaultMessage: {kind, select, pinned {{pins, plural, =0 {置顶帖子} other {你最近置顶的 # 条帖子}}} bookmarked {你加了书签的帖子} favourited {你喜欢的帖子} media {含媒体的帖子} polls {含投票的帖子} other {文章}}
settings.account.auto_delete.keep.description: A checkbox of Posts that are kept on the settings page Delete old posts automatically: a kind of post that is never deleted. kind is pinned, bookmarked, favourited, media, polls, or articles. pins is 0 where every pinned post is kept, else how many of the most recently pinned the server lets the reader keep (1 to 4). No full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.keep.item.defaultMessage: {item, select, age {超过 {days, plural, other {# 天}}的帖子} pinned {置顶帖子} bookmarked {你加了书签的帖子} favourited {你喜欢的帖子} media {含媒体的帖子} polls {含投票的帖子} articles {文章} audiences {按受众保留的帖子} thresholds {按转发或喜欢数保留的帖子} more {下方更多内容} other {你已保存的设置所保留的某些帖子}}
settings.account.auto_delete.keep.item.description: One thing in a list inside a sentence of the settings page Delete old posts automatically, joined to the others as the reader's language joins a list (A, B, and C): what a server's maximum does not let the reader keep (settings.account.auto_delete.keep.fixed, settings.account.auto_delete.bound.about). In lower case, since it never starts the sentence. item is age (posts past days days), a kind of post (pinned, bookmarked, favourited, media, polls, articles), audiences (posts kept for the audience they were made for), thresholds (posts kept for how often they were boosted or favourited), more (the last of a list cut after two: the rest is on the page below), or anything else when the page cannot tell which. No full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.keep.fixed.defaultMessage: 此服务器不允许你保留{items}。
settings.account.auto_delete.keep.fixed.description: In the section Posts that are kept of the settings page Delete old posts automatically, under its checkboxes: the kinds of post the server's maximum does not allow to be kept, which are not offered as checkboxes. items is those kinds, each as settings.account.auto_delete.keep.item, joined as the reader's language joins a list. The same sentence form as settings.account.auto_delete.audiences.about (allowed no) and settings.account.auto_delete.thresholds.fixed.

settings.account.auto_delete.section.aud.description: A heading on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, over the checkboxes of the visibilities (Public, Followers only…) whose posts are never deleted. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.audiences.a.defaultMessage: {allowed, select, yes {勾选一个受众，即保留你为其发布的所有帖子。} other {此服务器不允许你按受众保留帖子。}}
settings.account.auto_delete.audiences.a.description: In the section Posts kept by audience of the settings page Delete old posts automatically. allowed yes: the line under the heading, over the checkboxes. allowed no: all the section says, in place of its checkboxes, on a server whose maximum does not allow it.

settings.account.auto_delete.section.thr.defaultMessage: 按转发和喜欢数保留的帖子
settings.account.auto_delete.section.thr.description: A heading on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, over the two numbers of boosts and of favourites from which a post is never deleted. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.thresholds..defaultMessage: 此服务器不允许你按转发或喜欢数保留帖子。
settings.account.auto_delete.thresholds..description: All the section Posts kept by their boosts and favourites of the settings page Delete old posts automatically says, in place of its two fields, on a server whose maximum does not allow it.

settings.account.auto_delete.threshold.defaultMessage: {of, select, boosts {保留被转发至少以下次数的帖子} other {保留被喜欢至少以下次数的帖子}}
settings.account.auto_delete.threshold.description: The label of a number field on the settings page Delete old posts automatically: how many times a post must have been boosted (of boosts) or favourited (of favourites) to be kept; the unit times follows the field (settings.account.auto_delete.threshold.unit).

settings.account.auto_delete.threshold.u.description: The unit after the number fields Keep posts boosted at least and Keep posts favourited at least on the settings page Delete old posts automatically.

settings.account.auto_delete.threshold.a.defaultMessage: 设为 0 则不会因此保留任何帖子。
settings.account.auto_delete.threshold.a.description: The line under the number fields Keep posts boosted at least and Keep posts favourited at least on the settings page Delete old posts automatically: what 0 means.

settings.account.auto_delete.threshold.r.defaultMessage: 请输入 0 到 {max, number} 之间的整数。
settings.account.auto_delete.threshold.r.description: Under a number field of Posts kept by their boosts and favourites on the settings page Delete old posts automatically when the server refused its value. max is 1000000.

settings.account.auto_delete.section.cou.description: A heading on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, right under When posts are deleted, over the count of the reader's posts that the settings on the page would delete now, before they are saved, and the oldest of them. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.count.about.defaultMessage: 按此页面当前的设置、在你保存之前立即统计。服务器每小时最多删除 100 条帖子，因此大量旧帖子需要一些时间才能删完。
settings.account.auto_delete.count.about.description: Under the heading Posts that would be deleted on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, the second section of the page, right under When posts are deleted: what the count is of (every setting of the page, those under it too), and how fast the server deletes.

settings.account.auto_delete.count.off.defaultMessage: 自动删除关闭时，不会删除任何内容。
settings.account.auto_delete.count.off.description: In the section Posts that would be deleted of the settings page Delete old posts automatically while Automatic deletion is Off on the page.

settings.account.auto_delete.count.no_ag.defaultMessage: 请输入以天为单位的时长以统计帖子。
settings.account.auto_delete.count.no_ag.description: In the section Posts that would be deleted of the settings page Delete old posts automatically while the field Delete posts older than is empty.

settings.account.auto_delete.count.loadi.description: On the settings page Delete old posts automatically while the server counts what the settings on the page would delete: in the section Posts that would be deleted, and in the bar at the bottom right before Save, in the place of settings.account.auto_delete.save.count.

settings.account.auto_delete.count.defaultMessage: {more, select, yes {将删除你的超过 {count, number} 条帖子。} other {{count, plural, =0 {不会删除你的任何帖子。} other {将删除你的 # 条帖子。}}}}
settings.account.auto_delete.count.description: In the section Posts that would be deleted of the settings page Delete old posts automatically: how many of the reader's posts the settings on the page would delete now. more is yes when the server stopped counting at count (1000).

settings.account.auto_delete.count.faile.description: In the section Posts that would be deleted of the settings page Delete old posts automatically when the server did not answer the count; Try again follows it (settings.retry).

settings.account.auto_delete.count.oldes.description: The label over the list of up to 3 posts under the count on the settings page Delete old posts automatically: the oldest of the posts that would be deleted. No full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.count.post.description: A row of the list The oldest of them on the settings page Delete old posts automatically: one of the reader's posts that would be deleted, named by when it was posted, which the row opens; the start of its text follows. date is a date and a time as the reader's locale writes them. No full stop.

settings.account.auto_delete.save.description: The button in the bar at the bottom of the settings page Delete old posts automatically that saves the whole page.

settings.account.auto_delete.save.count.defaultMessage: {changed, select, yes {{more, select, yes {保存后会删除你的超过 {count, number} 条帖子。} other {保存后会删除你的 {count, number} 条帖子。}}} other {{more, select, yes {这些设置会删除你的超过 {count, number} 条帖子。} other {这些设置会删除你的 {count, number} 条帖子。}}}}
settings.account.auto_delete.save.count.description: In the bar at the bottom of the settings page Delete old posts automatically, right before Save, while the settings on the page delete at least one of the reader's posts: how many. changed is yes when the page differs from the settings in effect, so that saving is what deletes them, and anything else when it shows the settings in effect as they are. more is yes when the server stopped counting at count (1000). count is 1 or more. One short sentence.

settings.account.auto_delete.save.failed.defaultMessage: 无法保存你的设置。请重试。
settings.account.auto_delete.save.failed.description: In the bar at the bottom of the settings page Delete old posts automatically, beside Save, when the server did not take the page and gave no reason of its own (the network).

settings.account.auto_delete.save.refuse.defaultMessage: 请修正标记的内容后再保存。
settings.account.auto_delete.save.refuse.description: In the bar at the bottom of the settings page Delete old posts automatically, beside Save, when the page or the server found something wrong with a setting, which says what under that setting.

settings.account.auto_delete.ask.title.description: The question of the confirmation that opens when the reader presses Save on the settings page Delete old posts automatically and the save turns the deletion on or deletes posts the settings in effect keep (a younger age, fewer kinds kept).

settings.account.auto_delete.ask.text.defaultMessage: {counted, select, yes {保存后会删除你的 {count, number} 条帖子。此操作无法撤销。} more {保存后会删除你的超过 {count, number} 条帖子。此操作无法撤销。} none {你还没有帖子旧到可以删除。帖子超过 {days, plural, other {# 天}}后会被删除。此操作无法撤销。} other {保存后会删除你超过 {days, plural, other {# 天}}且未保留的帖子。此操作无法撤销。}}
settings.account.auto_delete.ask.text.description: The text of the confirmation that asks whether to save the settings page Delete old posts automatically: what the save deletes, and that deleted posts cannot be restored. counted is yes when the server counted count posts (1 or more), more when it stopped counting at count (1000), none when it counted none, and anything else while the count is not known (still counting, or it failed). days is the age past which a post is deleted, 1 or more.

settings.account.auto_delete.ask.confirm.defaultMessage: {deletes, select, yes {保存并删除} other {保存}}
settings.account.auto_delete.ask.confirm.description: The button of the confirmation on the settings page Delete old posts automatically that saves the page. deletes is yes when the save deletes posts now, or may (the count is not known), and anything else when no post is old enough yet.

settings.account.auto_delete.ask.cancel.description: The button of the confirmation on the settings page Delete old posts automatically that closes it without saving; the page stays as the reader made it.

settings.account.auto_delete.leave.title.description: The question of the confirmation that opens when the reader leaves the settings page Delete old posts automatically with changes they did not save.

settings.account.auto_delete.leave.text.defaultMessage: 你尚未保存的更改将会丢失。此操作无法撤销。
settings.account.auto_delete.leave.text.description: The text of the confirmation that asks whether to leave the settings page Delete old posts automatically without saving.

settings.account.auto_delete.leave.confi.description: The button of the confirmation that leaves the settings page Delete old posts automatically, the changes lost.

settings.account.auto_delete.leave.cance.description: The button of the confirmation that stays on the settings page Delete old posts automatically, with the changes as the reader made them.

settings.account.aliases.description: A row of the section Moving to this account on the settings page Account and data, and the title of the page it opens, where the reader names the accounts they move from. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.aliases.row.about.defaultMessage: 填写你要迁出的账号，让其关注者可以迁到这里
settings.account.aliases.row.about.description: The line under the row Aliases on the settings page Account and data while the reader has no alias: what the page is for. A phrase without a full stop.

settings.account.aliases.row.standing.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {# 个账号可以把其关注者迁到这里}}
settings.account.aliases.row.standing.description: The line under the row Aliases on the settings page Account and data, in place of settings.account.aliases.row.about, while the reader has aliases: how many. count is 1 to 5. Without a full stop.

settings.account.aliases.loading.description: On the settings page Aliases while the reader's aliases are read from the server.

settings.account.aliases.failed.description: On the settings page Aliases when the reader's aliases could not be read (the network, the server); Try again follows it (settings.retry).

settings.account.aliases.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {没有别名} other {# / {max, number} 个别名}}
settings.account.aliases.count.description: The heading of the list on the settings page Aliases, whose title already names it: how many aliases the reader has, of the most an account can have (max is 5). A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.aliases.about.defaultMessage: 别名是你要迁出的账号。在此填写后，该账号才能把其关注者迁到这个账号，不会改变其他任何内容：迁移要在那个账号上发起。
settings.account.aliases.about.description: Under the heading of the list on the settings page Aliases: what an alias is for, and that it does nothing by itself.

settings.account.aliases.empty.defaultMessage: 请在下方添加你要迁出的账号。
settings.account.aliases.empty.description: In place of the list on the settings page Aliases while the reader has no alias; the section Add an alias follows.

settings.account.aliases.added.description: A fact under an alias in the list on the settings page Aliases: when the reader added it. date is a day as the reader's locale writes it. No full stop.

settings.account.aliases.remove.description: The button of a row of the list on the settings page Aliases that removes that alias at once; the row names the account.

settings.account.aliases.removed.description: What a row of the list on the settings page Aliases says once the reader removed that alias, in place of its button and its facts, the row staying where it was until they leave the page. Without a full stop.

settings.account.aliases.removed.spoken.description: What assistive technology reads in place of settings.account.aliases.removed, where the focus goes once an alias is removed. name is the account's handle (@user@domain), or its address where the server knows no handle.

settings.account.aliases.remove.failed.defaultMessage: 未能完成移除别名 {name}。请重试。
settings.account.aliases.remove.failed.description: Under the list on the settings page Aliases when removing an alias got no answer from the server (the network); the row and its button stay, to press again. name is as in settings.account.aliases.removed.spoken.

settings.account.aliases.add.description: A heading on the settings page Aliases, over the field that adds an alias by the account's address. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.aliases.add.label.description: The label of the field on the settings page Aliases where the reader enters the account to add as an alias.

settings.account.aliases.add.hint.defaultMessage: 其用户名，例如 @name@example.com，或其个人资料的地址。
settings.account.aliases.add.hint.description: The hint of a field that takes an account by its address, on the settings pages Aliases (Account you are moving from) and Move account (Account you are moving to): what the server takes.

settings.account.aliases.add.submit.description: The button under the field Account you are moving from on the settings page Aliases that adds that account as an alias.

settings.account.aliases.add.missing.defaultMessage: 请输入账号的用户名或地址。
settings.account.aliases.add.missing.description: Under the field Account you are moving from on the settings page Aliases when the reader pressed Add with the field empty.

settings.account.aliases.add.invalid.defaultMessage: 在那里没有找到可作为别名的账号。请检查用户名（例如 @name@example.com）或个人资料的地址。你自己的账号不能作为别名。
settings.account.aliases.add.invalid.description: Under the field Account you are moving from on the settings page Aliases when the server found no account at what the reader entered, or one that cannot be an alias (the reader's own, something that is no account).

settings.account.aliases.add.failed.description: The status of the section Add an alias on the settings page Aliases when adding got no answer from the server (the network).

settings.account.aliases.add.done.description: The status of the section Add an alias on the settings page Aliases once the server added the alias, which the list above then shows.

settings.account.aliases.full.defaultMessage: 你已有 {max, number} 个别名，已达账号上限。请先移除一个再添加。
settings.account.aliases.full.description: In the section Add an alias of the settings page Aliases, in place of the field, while the reader has the most aliases an account can have; also its status when the server refused one more. max is 5.

settings.account.departure.description: A heading on the settings page Account and data, over the row that leads to Move account: moving this account's followers to another account. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.move.description: A row of the section Moving to another account on the settings page Account and data, and the title of the page it opens, where the reader moves this account's followers to another account. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.move.row.about.defaultMessage: 把你的关注者迁到你的另一个账号
settings.account.move.row.about.description: The line under the row Move account on the settings page Account and data: what the page behind it does. Without a full stop.

settings.account.move.row.standing.description: The line under the row Move account on the settings page Account and data, in place of settings.account.move.row.about, while this account has moved. {handle} is the handle of the account, as @name@example.com. Without a full stop.

settings.account.end.description: A heading on the settings page Account and data, over the rows that lead to Deactivate account and Delete account, the last section of the page. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.description: A row of the last section on the settings page Account and data, and the title of the page it opens, where the reader deactivates their account: it is hidden, and deleted later unless they sign in again. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.row.about.defaultMessage: 隐藏你的账号和帖子；若你没有及时再次登录，它们会被删除
settings.account.deactivate.row.about.description: The line under the row Deactivate account on the settings page Account and data: what the page behind it does. Without a full stop.
