settings.account.delete.row.about.defaultMessage: 立即永久删除你的账号和帖子
settings.account.delete.row.about.description: The line under the row Delete account on the settings page Account and data: what the page behind it does. Without a full stop.

settings.account.loading.description: On the settings pages Move account, Deactivate account and Delete account, in place of their sections while what they show is on its way.

settings.account.failed.description: On the settings pages Move account, Deactivate account and Delete account, in place of their sections when what they show could not be read; the button Try again follows it.

settings.account.end.signed_out.defaultMessage: 你会在所有地方退出登录
settings.account.end.signed_out.description: A fact in the first section of the settings pages Deactivate account and Delete account: what deactivating or deleting the account does to where the reader is signed in. Strong, over settings.account.end.signed_out.about. No full stop.

settings.account.end.signed_out.about.defaultMessage: 所有浏览器和应用会立即退出登录，包括当前这个。
settings.account.end.signed_out.about.description: The muted line under the fact You are signed out everywhere on the settings pages Deactivate account and Delete account.

settings.account.move.effect.description: The heading of the first section of the settings page Move account: what moves, what does not, and what becomes of this account. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.move.effect.followers.description: A fact in the section What a move does of the settings page Move account: the one thing that moves. Strong, over settings.account.move.effect.followers.about. No full stop.

settings.account.move.effect.followers.a.defaultMessage: 他们会关注你迁往的账号，而不再关注这个账号。
settings.account.move.effect.followers.a.description: The muted line under the fact Your followers move on the settings page Move account.

settings.account.move.effect.stays.description: A fact in the section What a move does of the settings page Move account: what does not move. Strong, over settings.account.move.effect.stays.about. No full stop.

settings.account.move.effect.stays.about.defaultMessage: 你的帖子、你关注的账号、你的屏蔽、静音和书签都不会迁移。
settings.account.move.effect.stays.about.description: The muted line under the fact Everything else stays here on the settings page Move account.

settings.account.move.effect.account.defaultMessage: 此账号将不能再发帖或关注
settings.account.move.effect.account.description: A fact in the section What a move does of the settings page Move account: what becomes of the account that moves. Strong, over settings.account.move.effect.account.about. No full stop.

settings.account.move.effect.account.abo.defaultMessage: 其个人资料会说明你迁往何处。你仍可登录、阅读、导出数据和删除账号，但不能发帖、转发、回应、关注或投票。
settings.account.move.effect.account.abo.description: The muted line under the fact This account can no longer post or follow on the settings page Move account.

settings.account.move.effect.wait.defaultMessage: {days, plural, other {# 天}}内你不能再次迁移
settings.account.move.effect.wait.description: A fact in the section What a move does of the settings page Move account: how long the account waits before another move. days is 30. Strong, over settings.account.move.effect.wait.about. No full stop.

settings.account.move.effect.wait.about.defaultMessage: 取消迁移不会缩短等待时间，也不会让关注者回来。
settings.account.move.effect.wait.about.description: The muted line under the fact You cannot move again for 30 days on the settings page Move account.

settings.account.move.effect.export.defaultMessage: 若要带走你的关注、屏蔽、静音和书签，请在此将其导出为 CSV 文件，并在另一个账号上导入。
settings.account.move.effect.export.description: A sentence at the end of the section What a move does of the settings page Move account; the link Export (settings.account.export) follows it.

settings.account.move.alias.defaultMessage: 首先，在你要迁往的账号上
settings.account.move.alias.description: The heading of the second section of the settings page Move account: what the reader does on the other account before the move. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.move.alias.about.defaultMessage: 在那里把此账号添加为别名：在其设置的“账号和数据”下打开“别名”，在“添加别名”中输入此用户名。其他软件在类似名称下也有同样的功能。
settings.account.move.alias.about.description: The line under the heading First, on the account you are moving to of the settings page Move account, over this account's handle. Account and data, Aliases and Add an alias are settings.entry.account, settings.account.aliases and settings.account.aliases.add: the same words.

settings.account.move.alias.handle.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the box on the settings page Move account that holds this account's handle (@name@example.com) for the reader to copy.

settings.account.move.alias.copy.description: The button under this account's handle on the settings page Move account: it copies the handle.

settings.account.move.form.description: The heading of the last section of the settings page Move account, over the field Account you are moving to. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.move.target.description: The label of the field on the settings page Move account where the reader names the account this one moves to; its hint is settings.account.aliases.add.hint.

settings.account.move.target.missing.defaultMessage: 请输入你要迁往的账号的用户名或地址。
settings.account.move.target.missing.description: Under the field Account you are moving to on the settings page Move account, when the reader chose Move account with the field empty.

settings.account.move.target.not_found.defaultMessage: 在那里没有找到账号。请检查用户名（例如 @name@example.com）或个人资料的地址。
settings.account.move.target.not_found.description: Under the field Account you are moving to on the settings page Move account, when the server found no account at what the reader entered.

settings.account.move.target.own.defaultMessage: 那就是此账号。请输入你要迁往的账号。
settings.account.move.target.own.description: Under the field Account you are moving to on the settings page Move account, when the reader entered this account itself.

settings.account.move.refused.defaultMessage: {reason, select, alias_missing {{handle} 尚未把此账号列为别名。请在那个账号的“别名”中添加此账号，然后重试。} target_moved {{handle} 自己已迁移到另一个账号。请输入它迁往的账号。} target_unavailable {你不能迁移到 {handle}：此服务器无法连接该账号，或不接受它。请检查用户名，或选择另一个账号。} other {此账号以前已迁移到 {handle}，每个账号只能迁移一次，即使那次迁移已取消。请选择另一个账号。}}
settings.account.move.refused.description: On the settings page Move account, why the server refused the move to the account named, once the reader confirmed it, under the field Account you are moving to: it does not list this account as an alias (alias_missing), moved itself (target_moved), cannot be moved to (target_unavailable), or this account moved to it before (anything else: repeated). {handle} is the handle of the account, as @name@example.com. Aliases is settings.account.aliases: the same word.

settings.account.move.confirm.defaultMessage: 你的关注者会迁移到 {handle}，其他一切留在这里。之后取消迁移不会让他们回来，且此账号在 {days, plural, other {# 天}}内不能再次迁移。
settings.account.move.confirm.description: In the dialog Move this account to…?, opened by the button Move account on the settings page Move account: what its button does, what stays, and what cancelling the move later does not undo, over how the reader confirms it's them. {handle} is the handle of the account, as @name@example.com. days is 30.

settings.account.move.confirm.title.description: The title of the dialog opened by the button Move account on the settings page Move account, whose button Move account moves the account. {handle} is the handle of the account, as @name@example.com.

settings.account.move.submit.description: The button that ends the settings page Move account: it asks the reader to confirm it's them, then moves the account.

settings.account.move.moved.description: The summary at the top of the settings page Move account while this account has moved. {handle} is the handle of the account, as @name@example.com. A sentence as a heading: no full stop.

settings.account.move.moved.about.defaultMessage: 其关注者已迁到那里。此账号不能发帖、转发、回应、关注或投票；你仍可登录、阅读、导出数据和删除账号。
settings.account.move.moved.about.description: The muted line under the summary This account moved to… on the settings page Move account.

settings.account.move.cancel.description: The heading of the section of the settings page Move account that holds the button Cancel the move, while this account has moved. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.move.cancel.about.defaultMessage: 取消后，此账号可以再次发帖和关注，并告知其他服务器它不再处于迁移状态。已迁移的关注者会留在 {handle}，再次迁移前的 {days, plural, other {# 天}}仍从这次迁移起算。
settings.account.move.cancel.about.description: The line under the heading Cancelling the move on the settings page Move account: what cancelling does and does not undo. {handle} is the handle of the account, as @name@example.com. days is 30.

settings.account.move.cancel.submit.description: The button of the section Cancelling the move on the settings page Move account, and the confirming button of the dialog it opens; also the link under the summary This account cannot be deactivated now on the settings page Deactivate account, for an account that moved, which leads to Move account.

settings.account.move.cancel.title.description: The title of the dialog opened by the button Cancel the move on the settings page Move account. {handle} is the handle of the account, as @name@example.com.

settings.account.move.cancel.text.defaultMessage: 已迁移的关注者不会回来，此账号在这次迁移后 {days, plural, other {# 天}}内仍不能再次迁移。
settings.account.move.cancel.text.description: The text of the dialog Cancel the move to…? on the settings page Move account: what cancelling does not undo. days is 30.

settings.account.move.cancel.keep.description: The button of the dialog Cancel the move to…? on the settings page Move account that closes it and cancels nothing, beside Cancel the move.

settings.account.move.cancelled.description: The summary at the top of the settings page Move account once the reader cancelled the move. A sentence as a heading: no full stop.

settings.account.move.cancelled.about.defaultMessage: 此账号可以再次发帖和关注。已迁移的关注者会留在另一个账号。
settings.account.move.cancelled.about.description: The muted line under the summary The move is cancelled on the settings page Move account.

settings.account.move.later.description: The summary at the end of the settings page Move account, in place of the field and the button Move account, while the server says the account cannot move yet (30 days after its last move, also a cancelled one); settings.account.move.later.about says until when under it. A sentence as a heading: no full stop.

settings.account.move.later.about.defaultMessage: 此账号上次迁移于 {moved}（已取消的迁移也计算在内）。从 {date} 起可再次迁移。
settings.account.move.later.about.description: The muted line under the summary This account cannot move now on the settings page Move account, in place of the field and the button Move account, while the server says the account cannot move yet: the last move counts even if it was cancelled. moved is the day of that move, date the day and time from which the account can move again, as the reader's locale writes them. A move waits 30 days after the last one.

settings.account.move.later.about.unknow.defaultMessage: 此账号从 {date} 起可再次迁移。等待时间从上次迁移起算，即使那次迁移已取消。
settings.account.move.later.about.unknow.description: The muted line under the summary This account cannot move now on the settings page Move account, as settings.account.move.later.about when the server does not say when the account last moved. date is the day and time from which the account can move again, as the reader's locale writes it.

settings.account.deactivate.effect.description: The heading of the first section of the settings page Deactivate account. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.effect.hidde.defaultMessage: 你的个人资料和帖子会被隐藏
settings.account.deactivate.effect.hidde.description: A fact in the section What deactivating does of the settings page Deactivate account. Strong, over settings.account.deactivate.effect.hidden.about. No full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.effect.hidde.defaultMessage: 此服务器和其他服务器上都无人能看到。有些服务器会把该账号显示为已暂停，因为它们没有其他显示方式。
settings.account.deactivate.effect.hidde.description: The muted line under the fact Your profile and posts are hidden on the settings page Deactivate account. Suspended is what a moderator does to an account (凍結).

settings.account.deactivate.effect.dropp.defaultMessage: 其间不会有任何内容到达该账号
settings.account.deactivate.effect.dropp.description: A fact in the section What deactivating does of the settings page Deactivate account. Strong, over settings.account.deactivate.effect.dropped.about. No full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.effect.dropp.defaultMessage: 账号停用期间收到的提及、私信、通知和新关注者不会保留，你回来时也不会有。
settings.account.deactivate.effect.dropp.description: The muted line under the fact Nothing reaches the account meanwhile on the settings page Deactivate account.

settings.account.deactivate.effect.kept.description: A fact in the section What deactivating does of the settings page Deactivate account. Strong, over settings.account.deactivate.effect.kept.about. No full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.effect.kept..defaultMessage: 你的帖子、你关注的账号和你的关注者保持原样。
settings.account.deactivate.effect.kept..description: The muted line under the fact Everything else is kept on the settings page Deactivate account.

settings.account.deactivate.after.description: The heading of the second section of the settings page Deactivate account: until when the reader can reactivate the account, and what happens after. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.after.reacti.defaultMessage: 在 {date} 之前登录即可重新启用
settings.account.deactivate.after.reacti.description: A fact in the section Coming back of the settings page Deactivate account. date is the day and time the account would be deleted if it were deactivated now, as the reader's locale writes them. Strong, over settings.account.deactivate.after.reactivate.about. No full stop.
The muted line under the fact Sign in by… to reactivate it on the settings page Deactivate account.

settings.account.deactivate.after.delete.description: A fact in the section Coming back of the settings page Deactivate account. Strong, over settings.account.deactivate.after.deleted.about. No full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.after.delete.defaultMessage: 它会被永久删除，与“删除账号”相同。如果此服务器发送邮件，你会在停用时收到一封写明日期的邮件，删除前不会再有提醒。
settings.account.deactivate.after.delete.description: The muted line under the fact After that, the account is deleted on the settings page Deactivate account. Delete account is settings.account.delete: the same words.

settings.account.deactivate.first.description: The heading of the third section of the settings page Deactivate account, over the row that leads to Export. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.first.export.defaultMessage: 账号停用期间无法导出你的数据
settings.account.deactivate.first.export.description: The line under the row Export in the section Before you deactivate of the settings page Deactivate account. Without a full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.act.description: The heading of the last section of the settings page Deactivate account, over the button Deactivate account. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.act.about.defaultMessage: 系统会要求你确认是本人，然后退出登录。如果你不再操作，账号将在 {date} 被删除。
settings.account.deactivate.act.about.description: The line under the heading Deactivate this account on the settings page Deactivate account. date is the day and time the account would be deleted, as the reader's locale writes them.

settings.account.deactivate.act.about.he.defaultMessage: 确认后你会退出登录。如果你不再操作，账号将在 {date} 被删除。
settings.account.deactivate.act.about.he.description: In place of settings.account.deactivate.act.about on the settings page Deactivate account once the reader confirmed it's them at another service: the button then asks only whether to go ahead. date is the day and time the account would be deleted, as the reader's locale writes them.

settings.account.deactivate.submit.description: The button that ends the settings page Deactivate account: it asks the reader to confirm it's them, then deactivates the account and signs them out.

settings.account.deactivate.confirm.defaultMessage: 你将退出登录，除非在 {date} 之前再次登录，否则账号会在当天被删除。
settings.account.deactivate.confirm.description: In the dialog Deactivate this account?, opened by the button Deactivate account on the settings page Deactivate account: what its button does, over how the reader confirms it's them. date is the day and time the account would be deleted, as the reader's locale writes them.

settings.account.deactivate.confirm.titl.description: The title of the dialog opened by the button Deactivate account on the settings page Deactivate account, whose button Deactivate account deactivates it.

settings.account.deactivate.refused.description: The summary at the top of the settings page Deactivate account while the server would refuse the deactivation; settings.account.deactivate.refused.reason says why under it. A sentence as a heading: no full stop.

settings.account.deactivate.refused.reas.defaultMessage: {reason, select, login_restricted {某项审核措施使此账号无法登录。“账号状态”会说明是哪一项，以及如何申诉。} deletion_scheduled {此账号已在等待删除。“账号状态”会说明原因。} already_deactivated {此账号已停用。再次登录即可重新启用。} moved {此账号已迁移到另一个账号。请先在“迁移账号”中取消迁移。} registration_pending {此账号的注册申请仍在等待审核员批准。批准后再试。} paid_subscription {你的支持者计划仍在进行。请先取消，再停用账号。} last_administrator {这是唯一能登录的管理员账号，而停用的账号最终会被删除。请先让别人成为管理员。} recently_reactivated {此账号不久前刚重新启用。你可以从 {date} 起再次停用。} reactivated {此账号不久前刚重新启用。请明天再试。} other {服务器没有说明原因。请重新加载应用后再试。}}
settings.account.deactivate.refused.reas.description: The muted line under the summary This account cannot be deactivated now on the settings page Deactivate account: why, and what to do. date (recently_reactivated only) is the day and time from which it can be deactivated again; reactivated is the same without a known time. Account status and Move account are settings.account.status and settings.account.move: the same words.

settings.account.delete.effect.description: The heading of the first section of the settings page Delete account. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.delete.effect.gone.defaultMessage: 你的账号和帖子会立即删除
settings.account.delete.effect.gone.description: A fact in the section What deleting does of the settings page Delete account. Strong, over settings.account.delete.effect.gone.about. No full stop.

settings.account.delete.effect.gone.abou.defaultMessage: 它们会从此服务器消失，并通知其他服务器一并删除。
settings.account.delete.effect.gone.abou.description: The muted line under the fact Your account and posts are deleted at once on the settings page Delete account.

settings.account.delete.effect.final.description: A fact in the section What deleting does of the settings page Delete account. Strong, over settings.account.delete.effect.final.about. No full stop.

settings.account.delete.effect.final.abo.defaultMessage: 没有时间改变主意。如需保留一段时间的退路，请改为停用账号。
settings.account.delete.effect.final.abo.description: The muted line under the fact It cannot be undone on the settings page Delete account.

settings.account.delete.effect.username.description: A fact in the section What deleting does of the settings page Delete account. Strong, over settings.account.delete.effect.username.about. No full stop.

settings.account.delete.effect.username..defaultMessage: 包括你在内，任何人都不能再在此服务器上注册 {username}。
settings.account.delete.effect.username..description: The muted line under the fact The username is never free again on the settings page Delete account. {username} is the account's username on this server with its @, as @name.

settings.account.delete.effect.erased.defaultMessage: 数据会在 {days, plural, other {# 天}}后清除
settings.account.delete.effect.erased.description: A fact in the section What deleting does of the settings page Delete account. days is 7. Strong, over settings.account.delete.effect.erased.about. No full stop.

settings.account.delete.effect.erased.ab.defaultMessage: 在此之前，服务器会保留数据，并对所有人隐藏。
settings.account.delete.effect.erased.ab.description: The muted line under the fact The data is erased 7 days later on the settings page Delete account.

settings.account.delete.first.description: The heading of the second section of the settings page Delete account, over the row that leads to Export. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.delete.first.export.defaultMessage: 账号删除后无法导出任何内容
settings.account.delete.first.export.description: The line under the row Export in the section Before you delete of the settings page Delete account. Without a full stop.

settings.account.delete.act.description: The heading of the last section of the settings page Delete account, over the button Delete account. A heading: no full stop.

settings.account.delete.act.about.defaultMessage: 系统会要求你确认是本人。随后账号会立即删除，你也会退出登录。
settings.account.delete.act.about.description: The line under the heading Delete this account on the settings page Delete account.

settings.account.delete.act.about.held.defaultMessage: 确认后，账号会立即删除，你也会退出登录。
settings.account.delete.act.about.held.description: In place of settings.account.delete.act.about on the settings page Delete account once the reader confirmed it's them at another service: the button then asks only whether to go ahead.

settings.account.delete.submit.description: The button that ends the settings page Delete account: it asks the reader to confirm it's them, then deletes the account and signs them out.

settings.account.delete.confirm.defaultMessage: 账号及其帖子会立即删除，你也会退出登录。此操作无法撤销。
settings.account.delete.confirm.description: In the dialog Delete this account?, opened by the button Delete account on the settings page Delete account: what its button does, over how the reader confirms it's them.

settings.account.delete.confirm.title.description: The title of the dialog opened by the button Delete account on the settings page Delete account, whose button Delete account deletes it.

settings.account.delete.refused.description: The summary at the end of the settings page Delete account, in place of the button Delete account, while the server would refuse the deletion; settings.account.delete.refused.last_administrator says why under it. A sentence as a heading: no full stop.

settings.account.delete.refused.last_adm.defaultMessage: 这是唯一能登录的管理员账号。请先让别人成为管理员，再删除它。
settings.account.delete.refused.last_adm.description: The muted line under the summary This account cannot be deleted now on the settings page Delete account: the server keeps its last administrator who can sign in.

settings.security.sign_in.description: A section heading on the Security page of the settings, over the rows that open the password's page and, once it is on, the page of two-factor authentication. A noun: how the reader signs in.

settings.security.two_factor.off.description: The sentence of the status summary at the top of the Security page of the settings while two-factor authentication is off. It is the one place the page says so.

settings.security.two_factor.off.about.defaultMessage: 任何得知你密码的人都能登录。验证器应用中的验证码可以阻止他们。
settings.security.two_factor.off.about.description: Under settings.security.two_factor.off in the status summary: what it means that two-factor authentication is off, and what turning it on does. The authenticator app is an app on the reader's phone that shows six-digit codes.

settings.security.two_factor.off.about.p.defaultMessage: 开启后，登录时还会要求输入验证器应用中的验证码，因此即使有人能使用你的通行密钥或已关联的账号，也无法登录。
settings.security.two_factor.off.about.p.description: Under settings.security.two_factor.off in the status summary, in place of settings.security.two_factor.off.about, for an account that no password signs in (it has none, or the server limits sign-in to other services): what turning two-factor authentication on does for it. It must not speak of a password.

settings.security.two_factor.turn_on.description: The button of the status summary that leads to the page where the reader turns two-factor authentication on, and the button at the end of that page that turns it on once the code is entered.

settings.security.two_factor.on.description: The line under Two-factor authentication in its row when the server did not say since when it is on: it is turned on. With the date, the line is settings.security.two_factor.since.

settings.security.two_factor.since.description: The line under Two-factor authentication in its row. date is the day it was turned on, written out in the reader's language (Mar 3, 2026).

settings.security.two_factor.codes_left.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {没有剩余的恢复码} other {剩余 # 个恢复码}}
settings.security.two_factor.codes_left.description: A second line under Two-factor authentication in its row, under settings.security.two_factor.since, when few recovery codes are left (three or fewer). A recovery code signs the reader in once when they cannot use their authenticator app. count is how many are unused.

settings.security.two_factor.setup.defaultMessage: 添加到你的验证器应用
settings.security.two_factor.setup.description: The heading of the first section of the page that turns two-factor authentication on: it shows a QR code and a setup key.

settings.security.two_factor.setup.about.defaultMessage: 用验证器应用扫描二维码，或手动输入设置密钥。
settings.security.two_factor.setup.about.description: The line under the heading Add to your authenticator app.

settings.security.two_factor.setup.qr.description: The name of the QR code on the page that turns two-factor authentication on, for assistive technology.

settings.security.two_factor.setup.key.description: The name of the secret text shown under the QR code, which the reader may type into their authenticator app in place of scanning the code; for assistive technology.

settings.security.two_factor.setup.expir.defaultMessage: 验证器应用的设置已过期。请扫描新的二维码，然后输入新条目的验证码。
settings.security.two_factor.setup.expir.description: An alert beside the button Turn on when the reader took longer than the server keeps a setup (15 minutes): the page now shows a new QR code, and the entry the reader added to their app from the old one no longer works.

settings.security.two_factor.copy.description: The button under the setup key, and under the recovery codes, that copies them.

settings.security.two_factor.verify.description: The heading of the second section of the page that turns two-factor authentication on, with the field Authentication code.

settings.security.two_factor.code.description: The label of the field for a two-factor code: on the page that turns two-factor authentication on, and in the dialog that asks for a code before turning it off or making new recovery codes. The same words as the sign-in page's (auth.two_factor.code_label).

settings.security.two_factor.code.hint.defaultMessage: 验证器应用当前显示的六位数验证码
settings.security.two_factor.code.hint.description: The hint under the label Authentication code on the page that turns two-factor authentication on.

settings.security.two_factor.code.missin.defaultMessage: 请输入验证器应用显示的验证码。
settings.security.two_factor.code.missin.description: The error under the field Authentication code when the reader pressed Turn on with the field empty.

settings.security.two_factor.code.title.description: The title of the dialog that asks for a two-factor code before two-factor authentication is turned off or the recovery codes are made again.

settings.security.two_factor.enabled.description: At the top of the page that shows the recovery codes right after two-factor authentication was turned on.

settings.security.two_factor.recovery.description: The title and the section heading of the page that shows the recovery codes once; the name of the row about them on the page of two-factor authentication; and the name of the list of codes for assistive technology.

settings.security.two_factor.recovery.on.defaultMessage: 无法使用验证器应用时，每个恢复码可用于登录一次。请妥善保存：它们不会再次显示。
settings.security.two_factor.recovery.on.description: The line under the heading Recovery codes on the page that shows them once. It must say plainly that the codes will not be shown again.

settings.security.two_factor.recovery.re.defaultMessage: 你的新恢复码已就绪。旧的已失效。
settings.security.two_factor.recovery.re.description: At the top of the page that shows the recovery codes right after the reader made new ones.

settings.security.two_factor.recovery.le.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {剩余 # 个恢复码。无法使用验证器应用时，每个可用于登录一次。}}
settings.security.two_factor.recovery.le.description: The line under Recovery codes in its row on the page of two-factor authentication. count is how many recovery codes are unused (more than three).

settings.security.two_factor.recovery.fe.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {没有剩余的恢复码。请生成新的，以便在无法使用验证器应用时登录。} other {剩余 # 个恢复码。请在用完前生成新的。}}
settings.security.two_factor.recovery.fe.description: As settings.security.two_factor.recovery.left, when three or fewer recovery codes are unused: it asks the reader to make new ones.

settings.security.two_factor.recovery.re.description: The button at the end of the row Recovery codes, which asks for a two-factor code first; and the button of that dialog.

settings.security.two_factor.recovery.re.defaultMessage: 要生成新的恢复码，请输入验证器应用中的验证码，或尚未使用的恢复码。你现有的恢复码将失效。
settings.security.two_factor.recovery.re.description: The sentence of the dialog Enter a code (settings.security.two_factor.code.title) before new recovery codes are made.

settings.security.two_factor.on.heading.description: The heading of the first section of the page of two-factor authentication while it is on; also the name of the list of its one row, Recovery codes, for assistive technology.

settings.security.two_factor.on.about.defaultMessage: 无论用哪种方式登录，之后都要输入验证器应用中的验证码。
settings.security.two_factor.on.about.description: A sentence under the heading Two-factor authentication is on: what it does. It holds for every way to sign in (a password, a passkey, a linked account), so it names none.

settings.security.two_factor.on.about.si.defaultMessage: 无论用哪种方式登录，之后都要输入验证器应用中的验证码。自 {date} 起开启。
settings.security.two_factor.on.about.si.description: As settings.security.two_factor.on.about, with the day it was turned on. date is written out in the reader's language (Mar 3, 2026).

settings.security.two_factor.turn_off.ti.description: The heading of the last section of the page of two-factor authentication, which stands apart and holds the button Turn off.

settings.security.two_factor.turn_off.ab.defaultMessage: 关闭后，登录时无需验证器应用中的验证码。
settings.security.two_factor.turn_off.ab.description: The line under the heading settings.security.two_factor.turn_off.title: what turning it off means. It holds for every way to sign in (a password, a passkey, a linked account), so it names none.

settings.security.two_factor.turn_off.co.defaultMessage: 要关闭双重身份验证，请输入验证器应用中的验证码，或尚未使用的恢复码。
settings.security.two_factor.turn_off.co.description: The sentence of the dialog Enter a code (settings.security.two_factor.code.title) before two-factor authentication is turned off.

settings.security.two_factor.turn_off.description: The button of the section settings.security.two_factor.turn_off.title, which asks for a two-factor code first; and the button of that dialog.

settings.security.providers_only.defaultMessage: 在此服务器上，你只能通过其他服务登录，因此现在不能设置密码或添加通行密钥。
settings.security.providers_only.description: A sentence in the Sign-in section of the Security page of the settings, and in the place of the form on the pages that set a password or add a passkey, on a server whose administrators limit sign-in to external login providers (another service, such as GitHub). The same words as the sign-in page's notice (auth.sign_in.login_providers_only).

settings.security.password.description: A row of the Sign-in section of the Security page of the settings that opens the password's page, where the reader changes their password or sets one; and the title of that page.

settings.security.password.caption.description: The line under Password in its row, for an account that has a password: what its page does. Removing the password is a row of its own (settings.security.password.remove).

settings.security.password.none.description: The line under Password in its row, for an account that has no password (it signs in with a passkey or a linked account): its page sets one.

settings.security.password.change.description: On the password's page, for an account that has a password: the heading of the section with the field New password, and the button at the end of the page that changes the password.

settings.security.password.set.description: On the password's page, for an account that has no password: the heading of the section with the field New password, and the button at the end of the page that sets the password.

settings.security.password.ends.defaultMessage: 这会让你在其他浏览器和应用中退出登录。你的通行密钥和双重身份验证保持不变。
settings.security.password.ends.description: The line under the heading Change password or Set a password: what happens besides the password changing, said before the reader does it.

settings.security.password.new.description: The label of the field for the new password on the password's page.

settings.security.password.new.hint.defaultMessage: {min, number} 到 {max, number} 个字符
settings.security.password.new.hint.description: The hint under the label New password: how long a password may be. min and max are numbers of characters.

settings.security.password.new.invalid.defaultMessage: 请使用 {min, number} 到 {max, number} 个字符。
settings.security.password.new.invalid.description: The error under the field New password when what the reader entered is too short or too long. min and max are numbers of characters.

settings.security.password.change.confir.defaultMessage: 要更改密码，请确认是你本人。
settings.security.password.change.confir.description: The sentence of the dialog Confirm it's you (settings.confirm.title) that opens when the reader changes their password.

settings.security.password.set.confirm.defaultMessage: 要设置密码，请确认是你本人。
settings.security.password.set.confirm.description: The sentence of the dialog Confirm it's you (settings.confirm.title) that opens when a reader without a password sets one.

settings.security.password.set.done.defaultMessage: 你的密码已设置，其他浏览器和应用已退出登录。
settings.security.password.set.done.description: Beside the button on the password's page once a reader who had no password set one.

settings.security.password.changed.defaultMessage: 你的密码已更改，其他浏览器和应用已退出登录。
settings.security.password.changed.description: Beside the button Change password, on the password's page, once the password was changed.

settings.security.password.remove.description: The name of the last row of the Sign-in section of the Security page of the settings, for an account that has a password. The line under it says what removing does, or why it cannot be removed; the button Remove is at the row's end.

settings.security.password.remove.about.defaultMessage: 之后你将通过通行密钥或已关联的账号登录。移除密码会让你在其他浏览器和应用中退出登录。
settings.security.password.remove.about.description: The line under Remove password in its row, for an account that has a passkey or a linked account: what removing the password does, said before.

settings.security.password.remove.unused.defaultMessage: 你的密码目前不能用于登录此服务器。移除它会让你在其他浏览器和应用中退出登录。
settings.security.password.remove.unused.description: The line under Remove password in its row, in place of settings.security.password.remove.about, on a server that limits sign-in to other services (external login providers): the password signs nobody in now, and what removing it does.

settings.security.password.remove.last.defaultMessage: 密码是你唯一的登录方式。要移除它，请先添加通行密钥或关联账号。
settings.security.password.remove.last.description: The line under Remove password in its row, in place of settings.security.password.remove.about, for an account with no passkey and no linked account: why the password cannot be removed, and what to do first. The row then has no button.

settings.security.password.remove.submit.description: The button at the end of the row Remove password. It asks the reader to confirm it's them, then removes the password.

settings.security.password.remove.confir.defaultMessage: 要移除密码，请确认是你本人。
settings.security.password.remove.confir.description: The sentence of the dialog Confirm it's you (settings.confirm.title) that opens when the reader removes their password. The password itself is not a way to confirm this.

settings.security.password.removed.defaultMessage: 你的密码已移除，其他浏览器和应用已退出登录。
settings.security.password.removed.description: At the top of the Sign-in section of the Security page once the password was removed.

settings.security.two_factor.description: A row of the Sign-in section of the Security page of the settings, shown once two-factor authentication is on, that opens its page; and the title of that page.

settings.security.passkeys.description: A section heading on the Security page of the settings, over the list of the account's passkeys; also the name of that list for assistive technology.

settings.security.passkeys.about.defaultMessage: 用设备的屏幕锁代替密码登录。
settings.security.passkeys.about.description: The line under the heading Passkeys: what a passkey is for. The screen lock is the device's fingerprint, face or PIN check. An account without a password reads it too, so it says a password, not your password.

settings.security.passkeys.unused.defaultMessage: 通行密钥目前不能用于登录此服务器，你也不能添加。你仍可以移除已有的通行密钥。
settings.security.passkeys.unused.description: The line under the heading Passkeys, in place of settings.security.passkeys.about, on a server that limits sign-in to external login providers, for an account that still holds passkeys.

settings.security.passkeys.add.description: The button at the end of the heading Passkeys (or under settings.security.passkeys.none) that leads to the page where the reader names a new passkey; the title of that page; and the button at its end that adds the passkey.

settings.security.passkeys.none.description: In the place of the list of passkeys while the account has none, over the button Add a passkey. The line above it (settings.security.passkeys.about) says what a passkey is for, so this one does not.

settings.security.passkeys.added.description: The line under a passkey's name in the list of passkeys. date is the day it was added, written out in the reader's language (Mar 3, 2026).

settings.security.passkeys.remove.description: The button at the end of a passkey's row, which asks before removing it; and the button of that confirmation (settings.security.passkeys.remove.title) that removes it.

settings.security.passkeys.remove.title.description: The question of the confirmation before a passkey is removed. name is the name the reader gave the passkey.

settings.security.passkeys.remove.text.defaultMessage: 你将无法再用它登录，且此操作无法撤销。该通行密钥会保留在你的设备上，直到你在设备上将其删除。
settings.security.passkeys.remove.text.description: Under settings.security.passkeys.remove.title in the confirmation: what removing a passkey does, and that it cannot be undone. The server forgets the passkey; the device still lists it until the reader deletes it in the device's own settings.

settings.security.passkeys.removed.description: At the top of the section Passkeys once a passkey was removed: its row is gone, and this line takes the keyboard's focus and is read by a screen reader. name is the name the reader gave the passkey.

settings.security.passkeys.new.description: The heading of the section with the field Name on the page Add a passkey.

settings.security.passkeys.add.about.defaultMessage: 通行密钥使用此设备的屏幕锁（指纹、面部或 PIN）代替密码登录。如果已开启双重身份验证，你仍需输入验证码。
settings.security.passkeys.add.about.description: The line under the heading New passkey on the page Add a passkey: what a passkey does.

settings.security.passkeys.name.description: The label of the field for the name of a new passkey.

settings.security.passkeys.name.hint.defaultMessage: 用于与其他通行密钥区分的名称，例如所在设备
settings.security.passkeys.name.hint.description: The hint under the label Name on the page Add a passkey.

settings.security.passkeys.name.invalid.defaultMessage: 请输入不超过 {max, number} 个字符的名称。
settings.security.passkeys.name.invalid.description: The error under the field Name on the page Add a passkey when it is empty or too long. max is a number of characters.

settings.security.passkeys.add.confirm.defaultMessage: 要添加通行密钥，请确认是你本人。随后浏览器会要求你创建它。
settings.security.passkeys.add.confirm.description: The sentence of the dialog Confirm it's you (settings.confirm.title) that opens when the reader adds a passkey.

settings.security.passkeys.add.failed.defaultMessage: {reason, select, cancelled {通行密钥未添加：浏览器的对话框已关闭或已超时。请重试。} exists {此设备上已有你账号的通行密钥。请使用它，或在另一台设备上添加通行密钥。} unsupported {此浏览器不能使用通行密钥。请换一个浏览器或设备。} other {无法添加通行密钥。请重试。}}
settings.security.passkeys.add.failed.description: An alert beside the button Add a passkey when the browser made no passkey. reason says why: cancelled (the reader closed the browser's own dialog, or it timed out), exists (the device already holds a passkey of this account), unsupported (the browser has no passkeys), other (anything else).

settings.security.linked.description: A section heading on the Security page of the settings, over the list of the other services (external login providers) the reader can sign in with and of their accounts there that are linked to this account; also the name of that list for assistive technology.

settings.security.linked.about.defaultMessage: 用你在其他服务上的账号登录。
settings.security.linked.about.description: The line under the heading Linked accounts: what linking an account is for.

settings.security.linked.not_linked.description: The line under the name of another service in the list of linked accounts, when the reader has linked no account there.

settings.security.linked.since.description: The line under the name of another service in the list of linked accounts, when the reader has linked an account there. date is the day it was linked, written out in the reader's language (Mar 3, 2026).

settings.security.linked.since.unavailab.defaultMessage: 关联于 {date}。现在不能用此服务登录。
settings.security.linked.since.unavailab.description: As settings.security.linked.since, for a service the server's administrators turned off: the link stays, but it signs nobody in for now.

settings.security.linked.link.description: The button at the end of the row of another service the reader has linked no account at. It asks the reader to confirm it's them, then goes to that service to sign in.

settings.security.linked.unlink.description: The button at the end of the row of a linked account, which asks before unlinking it; and the button of that confirmation (settings.security.linked.unlink.title).

settings.security.linked.unlink.title.defaultMessage: 取消关联你的 {provider} 账号？
settings.security.linked.unlink.title.description: The question of the confirmation before a linked account is unlinked. provider is the name of the other service as the server's administrators wrote it (GitHub); it is not translated.

settings.security.linked.unlink.text.defaultMessage: 你将无法再用它登录，也不能用它确认是你本人。你之后可以再次关联。
settings.security.linked.unlink.text.description: Under settings.security.linked.unlink.title in the confirmation: what unlinking does, and that it can be undone by linking again.

settings.security.linked.unlinked.defaultMessage: 已取消关联你的 {provider} 账号。
settings.security.linked.unlinked.description: At the top of the section Linked accounts once a linked account was unlinked; it takes the keyboard's focus and is read by a screen reader. provider is the name of the other service as the administrators wrote it (GitHub); it is not translated.

settings.security.linked.confirm.defaultMessage: 要关联账号，请确认是你本人。随后你会在另一项服务上登录，然后回到这里。
settings.security.linked.confirm.description: The sentence of the dialog Confirm it's you (settings.confirm.title) that opens when the reader presses Link: why it asks, and what happens after.

settings.security.linked.done.defaultMessage: 已关联你的 {provider} 账号。现在可以用它登录。
settings.security.linked.done.description: At the top of the section Linked accounts, when the browser comes back from another service after linking an account there, and the account holds a link at that service. provider is the name of the service as the administrators wrote it (GitHub); it is not translated.

settings.confirm.external.error.defaultMessage: {reason, select, denied {此服务器不接受该服务上的那个账号。请在那里换一个账号，或联系管理员。} linked_elsewhere {该服务上的那个账号已关联到此服务器上的另一个账号。请先在那里取消关联，或关联其他账号。} already_linked {你已关联过该服务的账号。请先取消关联，再关联另一个。} mismatch {你在另一项服务上登录的账号与你已关联的账号不符。请用已关联的账号重试。} unavailable {现在无法使用该服务。请稍后再试，或使用其他方式。} rate_limited {尝试次数过多。请等一会儿再试。} expired {耗时过长。请重试。} other {通过另一项服务的登录未完成。请重试。}}
settings.confirm.external.error.description: An alert on a page of the settings when the browser comes back from another service (an external login provider) without the link or the confirmation the reader went there for. reason says why: denied (the server's conditions refuse that account), linked_elsewhere (another user of this server links it), already_linked, mismatch (the reader signed in at the service with an account other than the linked one), unavailable (the service is turned off), rate_limited, expired, other (anything else).

settings.security.browsers.description: A section heading on the Security page of the settings, over the list of the browsers signed in to the account; also the name of that list for assistive technology.

settings.security.browsers.name.description: The name of a browser in the list of signed-in browsers. browser and os are product names, not translated (Firefox, macOS).

settings.security.browsers.unknown.description: The name of a browser in the list of signed-in browsers when the server kept no record of which browser signed in.

settings.security.browsers.signed_in.description: A line under a browser's name in the list of signed-in browsers: the day it signed in. date is written out in the reader's language (Mar 3). The next line, settings.security.browsers.signed_in.from, says where from. In ja the three facts of a browser are labels (ログイン日:, ログイン元:, 最終利用:).

settings.security.browsers.signed_in.fro.description: The line right under settings.security.browsers.signed_in in the list of signed-in browsers: the IP address the browser signed in from. It must read as where the browser was when it signed in, not where it is now, and it must say so on its own: each fact is a line of its own. ip is an IP address.
As settings.security.browsers.signed_in.from, when the server kept no record of the address the browser signed in from.

settings.security.browsers.current.description: The first line under a browser's name in the list of signed-in browsers: marks the browser the reader is using now, before what is known of its sign-in.

settings.security.browsers.sign_out.description: The button at the end of a row of the list of signed-in browsers, on every browser but the one the reader is using. It asks before signing that browser out.

settings.security.browsers.sign_out.titl.description: The question of the confirmation before one browser is signed out. browser is the browser's name as the list shows it (settings.security.browsers.name: Firefox on macOS), or the text it sent of itself. A browser the list names Unknown browser gets settings.security.browsers.sign_out.title.unknown.

settings.security.browsers.sign_out.titl.defaultMessage: 让这个未知浏览器退出登录？
settings.security.browsers.sign_out.titl.description: The question of the confirmation before one browser is signed out, in place of settings.security.browsers.sign_out.title, for a browser the list names Unknown browser (settings.security.browsers.unknown).

settings.security.browsers.sign_out.text.defaultMessage: 该浏览器需要重新登录才能使用你的账号。你的密码、双重身份验证和应用保持不变。
settings.security.browsers.sign_out.text.description: Under settings.security.browsers.sign_out.title in the confirmation: what signing a browser out does and what it leaves.

settings.security.browsers.sign_out.conf.description: The button of the confirmations settings.security.browsers.sign_out.title and settings.security.browsers.sign_out_others.title that signs out.

settings.security.browsers.signed_out.description: At the top of the section Signed-in browsers once one browser was signed out: its row is gone, and this line takes the keyboard's focus and is read by a screen reader. browser is the browser's name as the list showed it (settings.security.browsers.name: Firefox on macOS), or the text it sent of itself. A browser the list named Unknown browser gets settings.security.browsers.signed_out.unknown.

settings.security.browsers.signed_out.un.defaultMessage: 该未知浏览器已退出登录。
settings.security.browsers.signed_out.un.description: As settings.security.browsers.signed_out, for a browser the list named Unknown browser (settings.security.browsers.unknown).

settings.security.browsers.sign_out_othe.defaultMessage: 让其他所有浏览器退出登录
settings.security.browsers.sign_out_othe.description: The button at the end of the heading Signed-in browsers, shown when another browser is signed in. It asks before signing out every browser but the one the reader is using.

settings.security.browsers.sign_out_othe.defaultMessage: 让其他所有浏览器退出登录？
settings.security.browsers.sign_out_othe.description: The question of the confirmation before every browser but the reader's own is signed out.

settings.security.browsers.sign_out_othe.defaultMessage: 除此浏览器外，所有浏览器都需要重新登录才能使用你的账号。你的密码、双重身份验证和应用保持不变。
settings.security.browsers.sign_out_othe.description: Under settings.security.browsers.sign_out_others.title in the confirmation: what it does and what it leaves.

settings.security.browsers.signed_out_ot.defaultMessage: 你的其他浏览器已退出登录。
settings.security.browsers.signed_out_ot.description: At the top of the section Signed-in browsers once every browser but the reader's own was signed out; it takes the keyboard's focus and is read by a screen reader.

settings.security.browsers.advice.defaultMessage: 如果你不认识某次登录，请让该浏览器退出登录、更改密码，并检查哪些应用可以使用你的账号。
settings.security.browsers.advice.description: A sentence under the list of signed-in browsers: what to do about a browser the reader does not recognize, for an account that can change its password. Two links follow it: settings.security.browsers.advice.password and settings.security.browsers.advice.apps. An account that cannot gets settings.security.browsers.advice.no_password.

settings.security.browsers.advice.no_pas.defaultMessage: 如果你不认识某次登录，请让该浏览器退出登录，并检查哪些应用可以使用你的账号。
settings.security.browsers.advice.no_pas.description: As settings.security.browsers.advice, for an account that has no password, or cannot change it on this server: it does not speak of changing the password, and only the link settings.security.browsers.advice.apps follows it.

settings.security.browsers.advice.passwo.description: A link after settings.security.browsers.advice that opens the password's page.

settings.security.browsers.advice.apps.description: A link after settings.security.browsers.advice that opens the Apps page of the settings, which lists the apps the reader allowed to use their account.

settings.confirm.title.description: The title of the dialog that asks the reader to authenticate again before something only they may do in the settings (changing the password, adding a passkey, linking an account, deleting the account).

settings.confirm.close.description: The name of the close button of the dialog Confirm it's you and of the dialog Enter a code; it cancels. Also the one button of the dialog Confirm it's you when the account has no way to confirm in this browser.

settings.confirm.cancel.description: The button that cancels, in the dialog Confirm it's you, in the dialog Enter a code, and in the confirmations of the Security page (removing a passkey, unlinking an account, signing a browser out) and of the Apps pages (revoking an app, making a new secret, deleting an app).

settings.confirm.password.description: The label of the password field in the dialog Confirm it's you.

settings.confirm.submit.description: The button of the dialog Confirm it's you that sends the password the reader entered.

settings.confirm.passkey.description: The button of the dialog Confirm it's you when the reader confirms with a passkey: the browser then asks for one.

settings.confirm.provider.description: The button of the dialog Confirm it's you when the reader confirms by signing in again at another service they linked. provider is the name of the service as the administrators wrote it (GitHub); it is not translated.

settings.confirm.provider.about.defaultMessage: 要确认是你本人，请再次登录 {provider}。随后你会回到这里，重复你刚才的操作。
settings.confirm.provider.about.description: The sentence of the dialog Confirm it's you when the reader confirms at another service they linked: the app is left for that service's page, and the reader comes back to the same page of the settings, where they do again what they started (settings.confirm.returned). provider is the name of the service; it is not translated.

settings.confirm.way.password.defaultMessage: 请输入当前密码以确认是你本人。
settings.confirm.way.password.description: The muted sentence of the dialog that asks before moving, deactivating or deleting the account, under what the button does, when the reader confirms it's them with their password (the field Current password follows).

settings.confirm.way.passkey.defaultMessage: 随后浏览器会要求使用你的一个通行密钥来确认是你本人。
settings.confirm.way.passkey.description: The muted sentence of the dialog that asks before moving, deactivating or deleting the account, under what the button does, when the reader confirms it's them with a passkey: pressing the button makes the browser ask for one.

settings.confirm.other.password.description: A text button in the dialog Confirm it's you that changes the way to confirm to the password.

settings.confirm.other.passkey.description: A text button in the dialog Confirm it's you that changes the way to confirm to a passkey.

settings.confirm.other.provider.description: A text button in the dialog Confirm it's you that changes the way to confirm to signing in again at another service the reader linked. provider is the name of the service; it is not translated.

settings.confirm.passkey.failed.defaultMessage: {reason, select, cancelled {未使用通行密钥。请重试，或用其他方式确认。} unsupported {此浏览器不能使用通行密钥。请用其他方式确认，或换一个浏览器。} other {无法验证通行密钥。请重试，或用其他方式确认。}}
settings.confirm.passkey.failed.description: An alert in the dialog Confirm it's you when the browser gave no passkey. reason says why: cancelled (the reader closed the browser's own dialog, or it timed out), unsupported (the browser has no passkeys), other (anything else).

settings.confirm.none.defaultMessage: 此浏览器没有可确认你身份的方式。请换一个能使用你的通行密钥的浏览器或设备。
settings.confirm.none.description: An alert in the dialog Confirm it's you for an account that can confirm with nothing in this browser (it has no password and no linked account, and the browser cannot use its passkeys).

settings.confirm.returned.defaultMessage: 你已通过 {provider} 确认是你本人。请重复你刚才的操作：这次不会再要求确认。
settings.confirm.returned.description: On a page of the settings when the browser comes back from another service where the reader confirmed it's them: what they had entered before leaving is gone, so the page asks them to do it again. provider is the name of the service as the administrators wrote it (GitHub); it is not translated. Without a name, the page shows settings.confirm.returned.unknown.

settings.confirm.returned.unknown.defaultMessage: 你已通过另一项服务确认是你本人。请重复你刚才的操作：这次不会再要求确认。
settings.confirm.returned.unknown.description: As settings.confirm.returned, when the page does not know the name of the service the browser came back from.

settings.confirm.returned.act.defaultMessage: 你已通过 {provider} 确认是你本人。请在下方再操作一次：这次只会询问是否继续。
settings.confirm.returned.act.description: On the settings pages Move account, Deactivate account and Delete account when the browser comes back from another service where the reader confirmed it's them: the reader does it again, and the dialog then asks only whether to go ahead, with no password. provider is the name of the service as the administrators wrote it; it is not translated. Without a name, the page shows settings.confirm.returned.act.unknown.

settings.confirm.returned.act.unknown.defaultMessage: 你已通过另一项服务确认是你本人。请在下方再操作一次：这次只会询问是否继续。
settings.confirm.returned.act.unknown.description: As settings.confirm.returned.act, when the page does not know the name of the service the browser came back from.

settings.confirm.failed.defaultMessage: 未能完成：无法连接服务器。请检查网络连接后重试。
settings.confirm.failed.description: An alert on the Security pages and the Apps pages of the settings when a change got no answer from the server. When the server answers with a refusal, its own words show instead.

settings.apps.authorized.description: A section heading on the Apps page of the settings, over the list of the apps the reader allowed to use their account (the server's own web app among them); also the name of that list for assistive technology, and the title of the page of one such app until its name is read.

settings.apps.authorized.origin.defaultMessage: {registration, select, first_party {此服务器自有的 Web 应用} user {由 {owner} 注册的应用} user_unknown {由此服务器某位用户注册的应用} metadata_document {来自 {host}} other {自行注册的应用，其信息由其自行声明}}
settings.apps.authorized.origin.description: Where an authorized app comes from: in the line under its name in the list, and on its own page. registration says how it was registered: first_party (the web app of this server, the one the reader is using), user (a user of this server registered it; owner is that user's handle, @hana), user_unknown (the same, when the user cannot be named), metadata_document (it is identified by a document at an address; host is that address's host name, which the server verified), other (it registered itself, and everything it says of itself is its own claim). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.origin.*).

settings.apps.authorized.about.defaultMessage: 你允许使用你账号的应用。请撤销你不再使用或不认识的应用。
settings.apps.authorized.about.description: The line under the heading Authorized apps: what the list holds, and what to do about an app in it.

settings.apps.authorized.none.defaultMessage: 目前没有应用可以使用你的账号。
settings.apps.authorized.none.description: In the place of the list of authorized apps while it is empty.

settings.last_used.description: A line of its own under the name of something that uses the account, in a list of the settings (a signed-in browser, an authorized app), and under the day an app was authorized on its own page. date is the day and the hour it last used the account, written out in the reader's language (Mar 3, 2 PM).

settings.apps.authorized.unused.description: In the place of settings.apps.authorized.last_used when the server has recorded no use of the account by the app.

settings.apps.authorized.website.description: A line under where an authorized app comes from, on the app's own page: the app's home page, which is the app's own claim and not verified by the server. url is the address the app declared. The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.website).

settings.apps.authorized.since.description: On the page of an authorized app: when the reader first allowed it. date is the day, written out in the reader's language (Mar 3, 2026).

settings.apps.own.description: A section heading on the Apps page of the settings, over the list of the apps the reader registered as their developer; also the name of that list for assistive technology.

settings.apps.own.about.defaultMessage: 你为机器人、脚本或自己的客户端注册的应用。
settings.apps.own.about.description: The line under the heading Your apps: what registering an app is for. A client is a program that uses the account through the server's programming interface.

settings.apps.own.none.defaultMessage: 你还没有注册应用。注册一个即可获得其客户端 ID 和令牌。
settings.apps.own.none.description: In the place of the list of the reader's own apps while it is empty, over the button Register an app and under the line settings.apps.own.about, which says what an app is registered for: this line does not repeat it.

settings.apps.own.off.defaultMessage: 服务器管理员已关闭应用注册。已注册的应用仍可继续使用。
settings.apps.own.off.description: A sentence in the section Your apps, in the place of the button Register an app, and in the place of the form on the page Register an app, on a server whose administrators do not let users register apps.

settings.apps.own.registered.description: A line under the name of one of the reader's own apps in the list, under the line of its type. date is the day it was registered, written out in the reader's language (Mar 3, 2026).

settings.apps.own.disabled.description: The state at the end of the row of one of the reader's own apps: the server's administrators disabled it.

settings.apps.type.description: The type of an OAuth app, in a developer's words, as a line under an app's name in the list of the reader's own apps. confidential: the app can keep a secret (a server, a bot). other: a public app, which cannot (an app on a phone or in a browser).

settings.apps.missing.defaultMessage: 你的应用中没有此应用。它可能已被撤销或删除。
settings.apps.missing.description: In place of the page of one app (an authorized app, or one of the reader's own) at an address that names none of them; the link settings.apps.missing.all follows it on the same line.

settings.apps.missing.all.description: The link after settings.apps.missing that opens the Apps page of the settings.

settings.apps.about.description: The heading of the first section of the page of an authorized app: where it comes from, its website, when the reader allowed it and when it last used the account; also the name of that list for assistive technology.

settings.apps.unverified.defaultMessage: 此服务器未验证此应用。其名称是应用自己的声明。
settings.apps.unverified.description: A sentence on the page of an authorized app that is not the server's own. The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.unverified).

settings.apps.permissions.defaultMessage: {risk, select, caution {需要你注意的权限} write {会进行更改的权限} other {仅读取的权限}}
settings.apps.permissions.description: A section heading on the page of an authorized app, over the permissions of one weight the reader granted it; also the name of that list for assistive technology. risk is caution (permissions that read direct messages, act as the reader, or administer the server), write (permissions that change something), or other (permissions that only read). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.group).

settings.apps.caution.dm.description: The line under a permission on the page of an authorized app: the app can read direct messages. The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.caution.dm).

settings.apps.caution.post.defaultMessage: 可以以你的身份发布、编辑和删除帖子
settings.apps.caution.post.description: The line under a permission on the page of an authorized app: the app can post, edit or delete posts as the reader. The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.caution.post).

settings.apps.caution.profile.defaultMessage: 可以更改你的个人资料
settings.apps.caution.profile.description: The line under a permission on the page of an authorized app: the app can change the reader's profile. The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.caution.profile).

settings.apps.revoke.heading.description: The heading of the last section of the page of an authorized app, which takes back what the reader allowed it; also the name of its one row's list for assistive technology.

settings.apps.revoke.row.defaultMessage: 禁止此应用使用你的账号
settings.apps.revoke.row.description: The name of the row in the section Revoke access: what revoking gives.

settings.apps.revoke.about.defaultMessage: 该应用将不能再用你的账号读取或更改任何内容。若要再次使用，请从该应用再次授权。
settings.apps.revoke.about.description: The line under settings.apps.revoke.row, for an app that is not the server's own: what revoking does, said before.

settings.apps.revoke.about.web.defaultMessage: 这是你正在使用的应用。撤销它会让你在所有浏览器中退出登录，包括当前这个。
settings.apps.revoke.about.web.description: The line under settings.apps.revoke.row, in place of settings.apps.revoke.about, for the server's own web app, the one the reader is using: what revoking it does.

settings.apps.revoke.title.description: The question of the confirmation before an authorized app is revoked. app is the app's name as the app gives it.

settings.apps.revoke.text.defaultMessage: 该应用会立即失去对你账号的访问权限。你之后可以从该应用再次授权。
settings.apps.revoke.text.description: Under settings.apps.revoke.title in the confirmation, for an app that is not the server's own: that the app can no longer use the account from that moment, and that it can be undone by allowing the app again.

settings.apps.revoke.text.web.defaultMessage: 这是你正在使用的应用。撤销它会让你立即在所有浏览器中退出登录，包括当前这个。之后你可以再次登录。
settings.apps.revoke.text.web.description: Under settings.apps.revoke.title in the confirmation, for the server's own web app, the one the reader is using: revoking it signs every browser out, this one too, and the reader can sign in again.

settings.apps.revoke.description: The button at the end of the row settings.apps.revoke.row, which asks before revoking; and the button of that confirmation (settings.apps.revoke.title) that revokes.

settings.apps.register.description: The button at the end of the heading Your apps (or under settings.apps.own.none) that leads to the page where the reader registers an app; the title of that page; and the button at its end that registers the app.

settings.apps.form.identity.description: The heading of the first section of the form that registers an app, with the fields Name and Website.

settings.apps.form.name.description: The label of the field for the name of an app the reader registers.

settings.apps.form.name.hint.defaultMessage: 显示在用户授权该应用的页面上。最多 {max, number} 个字符。
settings.apps.form.name.hint.description: The hint under the label Name of an app. max is a number of characters.

settings.apps.form.website.description: The label of the field for the address of the home page of an app the reader registers.

settings.apps.form.website.hint.defaultMessage: 可选。https 或 http 地址，显示在同一页面上。
settings.apps.form.website.hint.description: The hint under the label Website of an app: the field may stay empty; the same page is the one where people allow the app.

settings.apps.form.authorization.description: The heading of the second section of the form that registers an app, with the fields Redirect URIs and Scopes and the setting Type: what the app may ask for when someone allows it. A developer's word (OAuth).

settings.apps.form.redirect_uris.description: The label of the field for the redirect URIs of an app the reader registers. A developer's word (OAuth): the addresses the server may send the browser back to once someone allowed the app.

settings.apps.form.redirect_uris.hint.defaultMessage: 有人授权应用后，服务器可将浏览器送回的地址。每行一个，最多 {max, number} 个：https 地址、使用自定义 scheme 的地址（例如 com.example.app:/callback），或任意端口的 http://127.0.0.1。
settings.apps.form.redirect_uris.hint.description: The hint under the label Redirect URIs: what a redirect URI is for, then how to enter them. max is how many an app may have. com.example.app:/callback and http://127.0.0.1 are examples to keep as they are.

settings.apps.form.scope.description: The label of the field for the scopes of an app the reader registers, and of the field for the scopes of a token they issue. A developer's word (OAuth): the names of the permissions, such as read or write:statuses.

settings.apps.form.scope.hint.defaultMessage: 应用最多可以申请的权限，以空格分隔，例如 read write:statuses。应用不能拥有 admin、admin:read、admin:write 或 write:supporters。
settings.apps.form.scope.hint.description: The hint under the label Scopes of an app. read, write:statuses, admin, admin:read, admin:write and write:supporters are names of scopes, to keep as they are.

settings.apps.form.type.description: The heading of the section of the form that registers an app in which the reader chooses whether the app is confidential or public; also the name of that choice for assistive technology.

settings.apps.form.type.about.defaultMessage: 类型决定应用是否有密钥。之后无法更改。
settings.apps.form.type.about.description: The line under the heading Type on the page Register an app: what the choice decides, and that it is final.

settings.apps.form.type.choice.defaultMessage: {type, select, confidential {机密：能够保管密钥，如服务器或机器人} other {公开：无法保管密钥，如手机或浏览器中的应用}}
settings.apps.form.type.choice.description: One of the two choices of the type of an app the reader registers, with what it means. type is confidential, or other (public). The first word is the type's name, as settings.apps.type has it. No full stop: it is a choice.

settings.apps.form.type.fixed.defaultMessage: {type, select, confidential {这是机密应用：它有密钥。} other {这是公开应用：它没有密钥。}}类型无法更改。若要使用另一种类型，请注册新的应用。
settings.apps.form.type.fixed.description: A sentence at the end of the section App settings on the page of an app the reader registered: the app's type, which is shown and cannot be changed. type is confidential, or other (public).

settings.apps.form.missing.defaultMessage: {field, select, name {请输入名称。} redirect_uris {请至少输入一个重定向 URI。} other {请至少输入一个 scope。}}
settings.apps.form.missing.description: The error under a field of the form of an app when the reader sent it with that field empty. field is name, redirect_uris, or other (the scopes).

settings.apps.registered.description: The sentence that heads the page shown right after the reader registered an app, over the app's client ID and, for a confidential app, its secret. name is the name they gave it. No full stop: it is a heading.

settings.apps.registered.about.defaultMessage: 其客户端 ID 会保留在应用的页面上。其密钥只在这里显示这一次。
settings.apps.registered.about.description: Under settings.apps.registered, for a confidential app: which of the two values under it the reader finds again later, and which not.

settings.apps.disabled.defaultMessage: 服务器管理员已停用此应用
settings.apps.disabled.description: The sentence of the status summary at the top of the page of one of the reader's own apps while the server's administrators have it disabled. No full stop: it is a heading.

settings.apps.disabled.about.defaultMessage: {type, select, confidential {它的令牌已停止工作，也不会再恢复。在管理员重新启用之前，没有人能授权它，它也得不到新令牌。你仍可以生成新密钥、更改其设置或删除它。} other {它的令牌已停止工作，也不会再恢复。在管理员重新启用之前，没有人能授权它，它也得不到新令牌。你仍可以更改其设置或删除它。}}
settings.apps.disabled.about.description: Under settings.apps.disabled in the status summary: what it means that the app is disabled (every token of it was revoked, and stays revoked when the app is enabled again: people allow it again then), and what the reader may still do on the page, where the way to a token is then not offered. type is confidential (the app has a secret, which can still be made again), or other (a public app).

settings.apps.credentials.description: The heading of the section of the page of one of the reader's own apps that shows its client ID and offers a new secret and a token; also the name of that section's list for assistive technology.

settings.apps.client_id.description: The name of the public identifier of an app: the heading over it on the page that shows a new app's values, and the name of the value shown to copy, for assistive technology. A developer's word (OAuth).

settings.apps.secret.description: The name of the secret of a confidential app: of the row about it on the app's page, the heading over the secret on the page that shows it once, and the name of that value for assistive technology. A developer's word (OAuth).

settings.apps.secret.caption.defaultMessage: 仅在生成时显示。如果丢失，请生成新的。
settings.apps.secret.caption.description: The line under Client secret in its row on the page of a confidential app.

settings.apps.once.about.defaultMessage: 请现在复制并妥善保存：它不会再次显示。
settings.apps.once.about.description: The line under the heading of a value the server shows only once (Client secret, Access token, Refresh token), right over the value, on the page that shows it right after it was made. It must say plainly that the value will not be shown again.

settings.apps.secret.none.defaultMessage: 公开应用没有密钥。其客户端 ID 保留在应用的页面上。
settings.apps.secret.none.description: Under settings.apps.registered, in place of settings.apps.registered.about, for a public app: the page shows its client ID alone.

settings.apps.secret.rotate.description: The button at the end of the row Client secret, which asks before making a new secret; and the button of that confirmation (settings.apps.secret.rotate.title).

settings.apps.secret.rotate.title.description: The question of the confirmation before a new secret of a confidential app is made. app is the name the reader gave the app.

settings.apps.secret.rotate.text.defaultMessage: 应用现有的密钥会立即失效，且此操作无法撤销。应用需要新密钥才能更新其令牌。它已持有的令牌仍可使用。
settings.apps.secret.rotate.text.description: Under settings.apps.secret.rotate.title in the confirmation: what making a new secret ends, that it cannot be undone, and what keeps working.

settings.apps.secret.rotated.description: The sentence that heads the page that shows the new secret of a confidential app right after the reader made it. No full stop: it is a heading.

settings.apps.secret.rotated.about.defaultMessage: 旧密钥已失效。应用需要新密钥才能更新其令牌。
settings.apps.secret.rotated.about.description: Under settings.apps.secret.rotated: what the new secret means for the app.

settings.apps.copy.defaultMessage: {what, select, client_id {复制客户端 ID} secret {复制密钥} access_token {复制访问令牌} other {复制刷新令牌}}
settings.apps.copy.description: The button under a value of an app shown to copy, which copies it. what is client_id, secret, access_token, or other (the refresh token): a page may show two of them, so each button names what it copies.

settings.copy.copied.description: Beside a button of the settings that copies a value shown to copy and keep (a setup key, recovery codes, a client ID, a secret, a token, an invite's link), once it was copied.

settings.copy.failed.defaultMessage: 无法复制。请选中文本后自行复制。
settings.copy.failed.description: Beside a button of the settings that copies a value shown to copy and keep (a setup key, recovery codes, a client ID, a secret, a token, an invite's link), when the browser refused to copy.

settings.once.done.description: The button at the end of a page of the settings that shows once what the reader must keep or pass on (recovery codes; a new app's client ID and secret, a new secret, an access token and a refresh token; a new invite's link). It goes back to the page the reader came from.

settings.apps.edit.description: The heading of the section of the page of one of the reader's own apps that holds the form to change it: its name, website, redirect URIs and scopes.

settings.apps.edit.about.defaultMessage: 更改从下次有人授权该应用时起生效。应用已持有的令牌保留其现有的 scope。
settings.apps.edit.about.description: The line under the heading App settings: what a change reaches.

settings.apps.edit.submit.description: The button at the end of the page of one of the reader's own apps that saves the form App settings.

settings.apps.delete.heading.description: The heading of the last section of the page of one of the reader's own apps; also the name of its one row's list for assistive technology.

settings.apps.delete.row.description: The name of the row in the section Delete app.

settings.apps.delete.about.defaultMessage: 该应用的所有令牌会立即失效，包括其他已授权它的人的令牌。此操作无法撤销。
settings.apps.delete.about.description: The line under settings.apps.delete.row, and under settings.apps.delete.title in the confirmation: what deleting the app ends, and that it cannot be undone.

settings.apps.delete.title.description: The question of the confirmation before one of the reader's own apps is deleted. app is the name the reader gave the app.

settings.apps.delete.description: The button at the end of the row settings.apps.delete.row, which asks before deleting the app; and the button of that confirmation (settings.apps.delete.title).

settings.apps.token.description: A row of the section Credentials on the page of one of the reader's own apps, which opens the page where the reader issues a token of the app for their own account; the title of that page; and the button at its end that issues the token. The developers' guide names it by these words.

settings.apps.token.caption.defaultMessage: 为你自己的账号签发访问令牌和刷新令牌，无需授权应用的页面
settings.apps.token.caption.description: The line under Issue token in its row: what its page gives.

settings.apps.token.heading.description: The heading of the section with the field Scopes on the page Issue token.

settings.apps.token.about.defaultMessage: 服务器为你自己的账号签发此应用的访问令牌和刷新令牌，无需授权应用的页面，也无需重定向。
settings.apps.token.about.description: The line under the heading Token for your own account on the page Issue token: what issuing a token does.

settings.apps.token.scope.hint.defaultMessage: 以空格分隔，在应用的 scope 范围内。留空则使用其初始的 scope。
settings.apps.token.scope.hint.description: The hint under the label Scopes on the page Issue token. The field starts with the scopes of the app that the reader's account may put in a token: all of them, but the permission scopes (admin:manage_invites) of permissions the account does not have. A field the reader emptied asks for those same scopes.
